source.text: וַיְהִי֙ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וּדְבַר־יְהוָ֗ה הָיָה֙ אֶל־אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖ית לֵאמֹ֑ר לֵ֚ךְ הֵרָאֵ֣ה אֶל־אַחְאָ֔ב וְאֶתְּנָ֥ה מָטָ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was [after] many days, and [the] word of Yahweh came to Elijah in the year the third, saying, Go, show yourself to Ahab, and I will give rain on [the] face of the ground.

en.L: And it was [after] many days, and the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Elijah in the third year, saying, "Go, show yourself to Ahab, and I will give rain on the face of the ground."
en.B: After many days, in the third year, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Elijah: "Go and appear before Ahab, and I will send rain on the land."
en.R: A long time passed. Then in the third year, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Elijah this message: "Go and let Ahab see you. I am going to send rain on the land again."

es.L: Y sucedió [después de] muchos días que la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a Elías en el tercer año, diciendo: «Ve, muéstrate a Acab, y yo daré lluvia sobre la faz de la tierra».
es.B: Después de muchos días, en el tercer año, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le habló a Elías: «Ve y preséntate ante Acab, y yo enviaré lluvia sobre la tierra».
es.R: Pasó mucho tiempo. Luego, en el tercer año, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Elías este mensaje: «Ve y deja que Acab te vea. Voy a enviar otra vez lluvia sobre la tierra».

fr.L: Et il arriva [après] de nombreux jours que la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Élie, la troisième année, en disant : « Va, montre-toi à Achab, et je donnerai la pluie sur la face du sol. »
fr.B: Bien des jours plus tard, la troisième année, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Élie : « Va te présenter devant Achab, et j’enverrai la pluie sur le pays. »
fr.R: Beaucoup de temps a passé. Puis, la troisième année, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné ce message à Élie : « Va te montrer à Achab. Je vais de nouveau envoyer la pluie sur le pays. »

sw.L: Ikawa [baada ya] siku nyingi, neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likamjia Eliya katika mwaka wa tatu, likisema, "Nenda, ujionyeshe kwa Ahabu, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaleta mvua juu ya uso wa nchi."
sw.B: Baada ya siku nyingi, katika mwaka wa tatu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Eliya, "Nenda ukajitokeze mbele ya Ahabu, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitanyesha mvua juu ya nchi."
sw.R: Muda mrefu ukapita. Kisha katika mwaka wa tatu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akampa Eliya ujumbe huu: "Nenda umwache Ahabu akuone. Nitanyesha mvua tena juu ya nchi."

vi.L: Sau nhiều ngày, lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Ê-li vào năm thứ ba, rằng: "Hãy đi, ra mắt A-háp, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban mưa xuống mặt đất."
vi.B: Sau nhiều ngày, vào năm thứ ba, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Ê-li: "Hãy đi ra mắt A-háp, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban mưa xuống đất."
vi.R: Một thời gian dài trôi qua. Rồi vào năm thứ ba, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Ê-li sứ điệp này: "Hãy đi gặp A-háp. Ta sắp cho mưa xuống đất trở lại."

ko.L: 그리고 여러 날이 지나 셋째 해에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 엘리야에게 임하여 말씀하셨다. "가서 아합에게 너를 보여라. 내가 땅 위에 비를 내리겠다."
ko.B: 여러 날이 지나 셋째 해가 되었을 때, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엘리야에게 말씀하셨다. "가서 아합 앞에 나타나라. 내가 땅에 비를 내리겠다."
ko.R: 오랜 시간이 흘렀다. 그리고 셋째 해에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엘리야에게 말씀하셨다. "가서 아합을 만나라. 내가 다시 땅에 비를 내리겠다."

pt.L: E aconteceu, [depois de] muitos dias, que a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio a Elias, no terceiro ano, dizendo: "Vai, mostra-te a Acabe, e eu darei chuva sobre a face da terra."
pt.B: Depois de muitos dias, no terceiro ano, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou a Elias: "Vai e apresenta-te a Acabe, e eu mandarei chuva sobre a terra."
pt.R: Passou-se muito tempo. Então, no terceiro ano, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu esta mensagem a Elias: "Vai e aparece diante de Acabe. Eu vou mandar chuva outra vez sobre a terra."

am.L: ከብዙ ቀናትም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ በሦስተኛውም ዓመት {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ወደ ኤልያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦ «ሂድ፤ ራስህን ለአክዓብ አሳይ፤ እኔም በምድር ፊት ላይ ዝናብ እሰጣለሁ።»
am.B: ከብዙ ቀናት በኋላ፣ በሦስተኛው ዓመት፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ኤልያስን እንዲህ አለው፦ «ሂድና በአክዓብ ፊት ቅረብ፤ እኔም በምድሪቱ ላይ ዝናብ እልካለሁ።»
am.R: ብዙ ጊዜ አለፈ። ከዚያም በሦስተኛው ዓመት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለኤልያስ እንዲህ የሚል መልእክት ሰጠው፦ «ሂድና አክዓብ እንዲያይህ ተገለጥለት። እኔ በምድሪቱ ላይ እንደ ገና ዝናብ ልልክ ነው።»

hi.L: और बहुत दिनों के बाद ऐसा हुआ कि तीसरे वर्ष में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन एलिय्याह के पास पहुँचा, कि "जाकर अपने आप को अहाब को दिखाओ, और मैं भूमि पर वर्षा दूँगा।"
hi.B: बहुत दिनों के बाद, तीसरे वर्ष में, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने एलिय्याह से कहा, "जाकर अहाब के सामने हाज़िर हो, और मैं देश पर वर्षा भेजूँगा।"
hi.R: बहुत समय बीत गया। फिर तीसरे वर्ष {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने एलिय्याह को यह संदेश दिया: "जाओ, और अहाब के सामने जाकर उसे अपना मुँह दिखाओ। मैं देश पर फिर से बारिश भेजनेवाला हूँ।"

ru.L: И было [по прошествии] многих дней, и было слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} к Илии в третий год, говоря: «Пойди, покажись Ахаву, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам дождь на лицо земли.»
ru.B: Прошло много дней, и на третий год {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Илии: «Пойди и явись к Ахаву, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пошлю дождь на землю.»
ru.R: Прошло много времени. И вот на третий год {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Илии: «Пойди и покажись Ахаву. Я скоро снова пошлю дождь на землю.»

uk.L: І було [по] багатьох днях, і слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} було до Іллі третього року, кажучи: «Іди, покажися Ахавові, і Я дам дощ на лице землі».
uk.B: Минуло багато днів, і третього року {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав Іллі: «Іди і стань перед Ахавом, і Я пошлю дощ на землю».
uk.R: Минуло багато часу. Тоді третього року {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав Іллі таке послання: «Іди і покажися Ахавові. Я знову пошлю дощ на землю».

decisions.choice: the third year: most likely the third year of the drought
alternatives: the third year of Elijah's stay in Zarephath
decisions.reason: The drought began when Elijah announced it to Ahab (17:1). "The third year" is most naturally counted from then, or from Elijah's stay in Zarephath (17:9). Luke 4:25 and James 5:17 speak of three and a half years without rain, which fits a drought that had run into its third year or beyond.

decisions.choice: show yourself: appear in person before the king
decisions.reason: The verb means "let yourself be seen". Elijah had been hidden since he announced the drought (17:3), and Ahab had searched for him everywhere (verse 10). Now he is to come out into the open.

decisions.choice: I will give rain: the drought ends at Yahweh's word
decisions.reason: Elijah had said there would be no rain except at his word (17:1). Rain is Yahweh's gift (Deuteronomy 11:13-17), not Baal's, the god of storm and rain whom Ahab served (16:31-32). The chapter shows who truly sends it.

decisions.choice: show yourself (Literal); present yourself (Balanced); let Ahab see you (Readable); the land (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the usual word for coming before a king. Balanced and Readable say "the land" for "the face of the ground".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of 1 Kings 18 (verses 3, 21, 36-37, 39).
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

source.text: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֵֽלִיָּ֔הוּ לְהֵרָא֖וֹת אֶל־אַחְאָ֑ב וְהָרָעָ֖ב חָזָ֥ק בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Elijah to show himself to Ahab; and the famine [was] severe in Samaria.

en.L: And Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. And the famine [was] severe in Samaria.
en.B: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria.
en.R: So Elijah went to meet Ahab. By this time there was a terrible shortage of food in Samaria.

es.L: Y fue Elías a mostrarse a Acab. Y el hambre [era] grave en Samaria.
es.B: Así que Elías fue a presentarse ante Acab. El hambre era grave en Samaria.
es.R: Así que Elías fue a ver a Acab. Para entonces había una terrible escasez de comida en Samaria.

fr.L: Et Élie alla se montrer à Achab. Et la famine [était] grave à Samarie.
fr.B: Élie alla donc se présenter devant Achab. Or la famine était grave à Samarie.
fr.R: Élie est donc allé voir Achab. À ce moment-là, la nourriture manquait terriblement à Samarie.

sw.L: Eliya akaenda kujionyesha kwa Ahabu. Na njaa [ilikuwa] kali huko Samaria.
sw.B: Basi Eliya akaenda kujitokeza mbele ya Ahabu. Wakati huo njaa ilikuwa kali huko Samaria.
sw.R: Basi Eliya akaenda kukutana na Ahabu. Wakati huo kulikuwa na upungufu mkubwa wa chakula huko Samaria.

vi.L: Ê-li đi ra mắt A-háp. Bấy giờ nạn đói [rất] trầm trọng tại Sa-ma-ri.
vi.B: Vậy Ê-li đi ra mắt A-háp. Lúc ấy nạn đói tại Sa-ma-ri rất trầm trọng.
vi.R: Vậy Ê-li đi gặp A-háp. Lúc ấy tại Sa-ma-ri đang thiếu lương thực trầm trọng.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리야가 아합에게 자기를 보이러 갔다. 그때 사마리아에는 기근이 심했다.
ko.B: 그래서 엘리야는 아합 앞에 나타나려고 길을 떠났다. 그때 사마리아에는 기근이 심했다.
ko.R: 그래서 엘리야는 아합을 만나러 갔다. 그때 사마리아에는 먹을 것이 없어 굶주림이 아주 심했다.

pt.L: E Elias foi mostrar-se a Acabe. E a fome [era] grave em Samaria.
pt.B: Então Elias foi apresentar-se a Acabe. A fome era terrível em Samaria.
pt.R: Então Elias foi se encontrar com Acabe. Nessa época, havia uma grande falta de comida em Samaria.

am.L: ኤልያስም ራሱን ለአክዓብ ሊያሳይ ሄደ። ራቡም በሰማርያ ጽኑ ነበረ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ኤልያስ በአክዓብ ፊት ሊቀርብ ሄደ። በዚያን ጊዜ በሰማርያ ራቡ ጽኑ ነበር።
am.R: ስለዚህ ኤልያስ አክዓብን ሊያገኘው ሄደ። በዚህ ጊዜ በሰማርያ አስከፊ የምግብ እጥረት ነበር።

hi.L: और एलिय्याह अपने आप को अहाब को दिखाने चला। और सामरिया में अकाल भारी [था]।
hi.B: तब एलिय्याह अहाब के सामने हाज़िर होने चल पड़ा। उस समय सामरिया में भारी अकाल पड़ा हुआ था।
hi.R: तब एलिय्याह अहाब से मिलने चल पड़ा। उस समय तक सामरिया में खाने की भारी कमी हो चुकी थी।

ru.L: И пошёл Илия показаться Ахаву. А голод [был] сильный в Самарии.
ru.B: И Илия пошёл, чтобы явиться к Ахаву. А в Самарии был сильный голод.
ru.R: И Илия пошёл к Ахаву. В это время в Самарии был страшный голод.

uk.L: І пішов Ілля, щоб показатися Ахавові. А голод [був] тяжкий у Самарії.
uk.B: Тож Ілля пішов, щоб стати перед Ахавом. А голод у Самарії був тяжкий.
uk.R: Тож Ілля пішов зустрітися з Ахавом. На той час у Самарії був страшний голод.

decisions.choice: the famine was severe: background to what follows
decisions.reason: The clause breaks off from the main story to describe the situation, which explains Ahab's search for grass in verses 3-6. The narrative returns to Elijah's meeting in verse 7.

decisions.choice: Samaria: the capital and, by extension, the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: Samaria was the city Omri, Ahab's father, built as his capital (16:24). Here it may mean the city or the whole region it ruled.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֣א אַחְאָ֔ב אֶל־עֹבַדְיָ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַבָּ֑יִת וְעֹבַדְיָ֗הוּ הָיָ֥ה יָרֵ֛א אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And summoned Ahab Obadiah who [was] over the house; and Obadiah was fearing Yahweh greatly.

en.L: And Ahab summoned Obadiah, who [was] over the house. And Obadiah was fearing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} greatly.
en.B: Ahab summoned Obadiah, who was in charge of the palace. (Obadiah was a man who deeply revered {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Ahab called for Obadiah, the man in charge of his palace. Obadiah had great respect for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and worshiped {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y Acab llamó a Abdías, que [estaba] sobre la casa. Y Abdías temía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en gran manera.
es.B: Acab llamó a Abdías, el mayordomo del palacio. (Abdías era un hombre que reverenciaba profundamente {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Acab mandó llamar a Abdías, el encargado de su palacio. Abdías respetaba mucho {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} adoraba.

fr.L: Et Achab appela Abdias, qui [était préposé] sur la maison. Et Abdias craignait beaucoup {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Achab fit appeler Abdias, le chef du palais. (Abdias était un homme qui craignait profondément {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Achab a fait venir Abdias, l’homme chargé de son palais. Abdias respectait profondément {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adorait.

sw.L: Ahabu akamwita Obadia, aliyekuwa [msimamizi] juu ya nyumba. Naye Obadia alikuwa akimcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sana.
sw.B: Ahabu akamwita Obadia, aliyekuwa msimamizi wa ikulu. (Obadia alikuwa mtu aliyemcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wote.
sw.R: Ahabu akamwita Obadia, mtu aliyesimamia ikulu yake. Obadia alimheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sana na kumwabudu.

vi.L: A-háp gọi Áp-đia, quan cai quản cung điện. Áp-đia rất kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: A-háp cho gọi Áp-đia, quan cai quản cung điện. (Áp-đia là người hết lòng kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: A-háp cho gọi Áp-đia, người cai quản cung điện của vua. Áp-đia rất tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 아합이 궁내 대신 오바댜를 불렀다. 오바댜는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 크게 경외하고 있었다.
ko.B: 아합은 궁내 대신 오바댜를 불렀다. (오바댜는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 깊이 경외하는 사람이었다.
ko.R: 아합은 자기 왕궁을 맡아 관리하는 오바댜를 불렀다. 오바댜는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 깊이 존경하며 섬기는 사람이었다.

pt.L: E Acabe chamou Obadias, que [estava] sobre a casa. E Obadias temia muito {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Acabe chamou Obadias, o encarregado do palácio. (Obadias era um homem que temia profundamente {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Acabe mandou chamar Obadias, o homem que administrava o seu palácio. Obadias respeitava muito {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} adorava.

am.L: አክዓብም በቤቱ ላይ የተሾመውን አብድዩን ጠራ፤ አብድዩም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እጅግ ይፈራ ነበር።
am.B: አክዓብ የቤተ መንግሥቱ ኃላፊ የነበረውን አብድዩን አስጠራ። (አብድዩ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እጅግ የሚፈራ ሰው ነበር።
am.R: አክዓብ የቤተ መንግሥቱ ኃላፊ የነበረውን አብድዩን ጠራ። አብድዩ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እጅግ የሚያከብርና የሚያመልክ ሰው ነበር።

hi.L: और अहाब ने ओबद्याह को बुलवाया, जो घराने के ऊपर [था]। और ओबद्याह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का बहुत भय मानता था।
hi.B: अहाब ने ओबद्याह को बुलवाया, जो राजमहल का अधिकारी था। (ओबद्याह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का गहरा भय माननेवाला था।
hi.R: अहाब ने ओबद्याह को बुलवाया, जो उसके महल का प्रबंधक था। ओबद्याह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का बहुत आदर करता था और उन्हीं की उपासना करता था।

ru.L: И призвал Ахав Авдия, который [был] над домом. А Авдий очень боялся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Ахав призвал Авдия, управляющего дворцом. (Авдий глубоко почитал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Ахав позвал Авдия, который управлял его дворцом. Авдий глубоко почитал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и поклонялся {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.

uk.L: І покликав Ахав Овдія, який [був] над домом. А Овдій дуже боявся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Ахав покликав Овдія, управителя палацу. (Овдій глибоко шанував {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Ахав покликав Овдія, чоловіка, що керував його палацом. Овдій дуже шанував {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і поклонявся {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.

decisions.choice: over the house: the steward who managed the king's palace and estates
decisions.reason: This was a high office at court (4:6; 16:9; 2 Kings 18:18; Isaiah 22:15). Ahab trusts Obadiah with the search for fodder for the royal animals (verse 5).

decisions.choice: feared Yahweh greatly: was devoted to Yahweh
decisions.reason: To fear Yahweh is to honor him as God and live in obedience to him (Proverbs 1:7; Deuteronomy 10:12). Obadiah's name means "servant of Yahweh", and in Ahab's court, where Baal was served (16:31-32), his loyalty was dangerous.

decisions.choice: the parenthesis opened here closes at the end of verse 4
decisions.reason: Balanced marks the note about Obadiah's past (verses 3b-4) as an aside, because the story of Ahab's order resumes in verse 5.

decisions.choice: had great respect for the LORD and worshiped him
decisions.reason: Readable explains "fearing" so that it is not taken as being afraid.

decisions.choice: "Abdías"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms table's form for Obadiah.

decisions.choice: parenthesis opened here, closed at the end of verse 4 (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced sets the note about Obadiah apart as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: "Abdias"
decisions.reason: The French form of the name in the terms note, the same as the prophet’s book.

decisions.choice: the parenthesis opened here closes at the end of verse 4
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced, the note about Obadiah's faith and his hiding the prophets is set in brackets across the two verses.

decisions.choice: kumcha BWANA
decisions.reason: To "fear the LORD" is "kumcha BWANA", the Swahili word for reverent fear of God, as the Psalms note sets; Readable says he respected and worshiped him.

decisions.choice: "Áp-đia"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form of Obadiah.

decisions.choice: the parenthesis opened here closes at the end of verse 4 (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the English in marking verses 3b-4 as background to the story.

decisions.choice: Obadias; [estava] sobre a casa (L), o encarregado do palácio (B), o homem que administrava o seu palácio (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Obadias" is the usual Brazilian form of the name, and his office (m1) keeps the words used for the same office at 4:6 in Portuguese. "Temer" stays at Literal and Balanced for the fear of the LORD (m2); Readable says "respeitava ... e adorava", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: over the house: "በቤቱ ላይ የተሾመ" (Literal); "የቤተ መንግሥቱ ኃላፊ" (Balanced, Readable); Balanced keeps the English parenthesis over verses 3b-4
decisions.reason: Obadiah is the steward of the king's household; Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase, the other levels name the office.

decisions.choice: Obadiah "ओबद्याह"; "घराने के ऊपर" (L), "राजमहल का अधिकारी" (B), "महल का प्रबंधक" (R)
decisions.reason: The steward over the king's house and estates (meaning m1). Obadiah is transcribed in the usual Hindi form.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Hindi of 1 Kings 18 (verses 3, 15, 21, 36, 37, 39)
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capitals; God's pronouns are honorific plural ("उन्हीं की", "तू" in prayer) at every level.

decisions.choice: "Авдий"
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian form of the name, as the book notes give it.

decisions.choice: "который [был] над домом" (L); "управляющий дворцом" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the title's Hebrew shape; the other levels say what the office was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "боялся ГОСПОДА" (L); "почитал ГОСПОДА" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Fear of the LORD" is reverence; Literal keeps the verb боялся, the other levels say почитать, as the English "revered".

decisions.choice: "Овдій" for Ahabʼs steward, the same name as the prophet in the terms note; "боявся ГОСПОДА" (L), "шанував ГОСПОДА" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is the same as the prophetʼs, so the Ukrainian form is too; the fear of Yahweh follows the terms note, Literal keeping the verb "fear".

source.text: וַיְהִי֙ בְּהַכְרִ֣ית אִיזֶ֔בֶל אֵ֖ת נְבִיאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֨ח עֹבַדְיָ֜הוּ מֵאָ֣ה נְבִאִ֗ים וַֽיַּחְבִּיאֵ֞ם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ בַּמְּעָרָ֔ה וְכִלְכְּלָ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם וָמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was when cut off Jezebel the prophets of Yahweh, and took Obadiah a hundred prophets and hid them, fifty man in a cave, and supplied them [with] bread and water.

en.L: And it was, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that Obadiah took a hundred prophets and hid them, fifty men to a cave, and supplied them [with] bread and water.
en.B: When Jezebel was killing off the prophets of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, Obadiah had taken a hundred of them and hidden them in caves, fifty in each, and had kept them supplied with food and water.)
en.R: When Queen Jezebel was killing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s prophets, Obadiah had taken a hundred of them and hidden them in two caves, fifty in each. He had kept them supplied with food and water.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Jezabel exterminaba a los profetas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Abdías tomó a cien profetas y los escondió, cincuenta hombres por cueva, y los sustentó con pan y agua.
es.B: Cuando Jezabel estaba matando a los profetas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Abdías había tomado a cien de ellos y los había escondido en cuevas, cincuenta en cada una, y los había provisto de comida y agua.)
es.R: Cuando la reina Jezabel estaba matando a los profetas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Abdías había tomado a cien de ellos y los había escondido en dos cuevas, cincuenta en cada una. Les había dado comida y agua.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Jézabel retrancha les prophètes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’Abdias prit cent prophètes et les cacha, cinquante hommes par grotte, et les ravitailla en pain et en eau.
fr.B: Quand Jézabel exterminait les prophètes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, Abdias en avait pris cent et les avait cachés dans des grottes, cinquante dans chacune, et il les avait ravitaillés en pain et en eau.)
fr.R: Quand la reine Jézabel faisait tuer les prophètes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, Abdias en avait pris cent et les avait cachés dans deux grottes, cinquante dans chacune. Il leur avait apporté régulièrement de quoi manger et boire.

sw.L: Ikawa, Yezebeli alipowakatilia mbali manabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Obadia akachukua manabii mia moja akawaficha, watu hamsini katika pango, akawapa mkate na maji.
sw.B: Yezebeli alipokuwa akiwaua manabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Obadia alikuwa amewachukua mia moja kati yao, akawaficha katika mapango, hamsini katika kila pango, akawa akiwapa chakula na maji.)
sw.R: Malkia Yezebeli alipokuwa akiwaua manabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Obadia alikuwa amewachukua mia moja kati yao, akawaficha katika mapango mawili, hamsini katika kila pango. Alikuwa akiwapa chakula na maji.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi Giê-sa-bên tiêu diệt các nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Áp-đia đã đem một trăm nhà tiên tri giấu đi, mỗi hang năm mươi người, và cung cấp bánh và nước cho họ.
vi.B: Khi Giê-sa-bên đang giết các nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Áp-đia đã đem một trăm nhà tiên tri giấu trong các hang, mỗi hang năm mươi người, và tiếp tế bánh và nước cho họ.)
vi.R: Khi hoàng hậu Giê-sa-bên đang giết các nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Áp-đia đã đem một trăm nhà tiên tri giấu trong hai cái hang, mỗi hang năm mươi người. Ông đã tiếp tế thức ăn và nước uống cho họ.

ko.L: 그리고 이세벨이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자들을 죽여 없앨 때에, 오바댜가 예언자 백 명을 데려다가 한 굴에 오십 명씩 숨기고, 그들에게 빵과 물을 대 주었다.
ko.B: 이세벨이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자들을 죽일 때에, 오바댜는 예언자 백 명을 데려다가 두 굴에 오십 명씩 숨기고 먹을 것과 마실 물을 대 주었다.)
ko.R: 이세벨 왕비가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자들을 죽이고 있을 때에, 오바댜는 예언자 백 명을 데려다가 두 굴에 오십 명씩 숨겨 주었다. 그리고 그들에게 먹을 것과 물을 날라다 주었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, quando Jezabel exterminava os profetas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que Obadias tomou cem profetas e os escondeu, cinquenta homens por caverna, e os sustentou com pão e água.
pt.B: Quando Jezabel estava matando os profetas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, Obadias tinha pegado cem deles e os tinha escondido em cavernas, cinquenta em cada uma, e os tinha sustentado com comida e água.)
pt.R: Quando a rainha Jezabel estava matando os profetas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, Obadias tinha levado cem deles e os tinha escondido em duas cavernas, cinquenta em cada uma. E ele tinha levado comida e água para eles.

am.L: ኤልዛቤልም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ነቢያት ባጠፋች ጊዜ አብድዩ መቶ ነቢያትን ወስዶ በዋሻ ሃምሳ ሰው አድርጎ ሸሸጋቸው፤ በእንጀራና በውኃም ቀለባቸው።
am.B: ኤልዛቤል {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ነቢያት በምትገድልበት ጊዜ አብድዩ ከእነርሱ መቶውን ወስዶ በዋሻዎች ውስጥ፣ በእያንዳንዱ ሃምሳ ሃምሳ አድርጎ ሸሽጓቸው ነበር፤ ምግብና ውኃም ሲያቀርብላቸው ነበር።)
am.R: ንግሥት ኤልዛቤል {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ነቢያት በምትገድልበት ጊዜ አብድዩ ከእነርሱ መቶውን ወስዶ በሁለት ዋሻዎች፣ በእያንዳንዱ ዋሻ ሃምሳ ሃምሳ አድርጎ ደብቋቸው ነበር። ምግብና ውኃም ያቀርብላቸው ነበር።

hi.L: और जब ईज़ेबेल {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को नष्ट कर रही थी, तब ओबद्याह ने सौ भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को लेकर, पचास-पचास पुरुष एक-एक गुफा में, छिपा रखा, और उन्हें रोटी और पानी पहुँचाता रहा।
hi.B: जब ईज़ेबेल {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को मरवा रही थी, तब ओबद्याह ने उनमें से सौ को लेकर पचास-पचास करके गुफाओं में छिपा दिया था, और उन्हें भोजन और पानी पहुँचाता रहा था।)
hi.R: जब रानी ईज़ेबेल {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नबियों को मरवा रही थी, तब ओबद्याह ने उनमें से सौ नबियों को दो गुफाओं में, हर गुफा में पचास-पचास करके, छिपा दिया था। वह उन्हें खाना और पानी पहुँचाता रहा था।

ru.L: И было, когда Иезавель истребляла пророков {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Авдий взял сто пророков и спрятал их по пятьдесят человек в пещере, и снабжал их хлебом и водой.
ru.B: Когда Иезавель истребляла пророков {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Авдий взял сотню из них, спрятал в пещерах, по пятьдесят в каждой, и снабжал их хлебом и водой.)
ru.R: Когда царица Иезавель убивала пророков {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Авдий спрятал сто из них в двух пещерах, по пятьдесят в каждой. Он приносил им еду и воду.

uk.L: І було, коли Єзавель винищувала пророків {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, то Овдій узяв сто пророків і сховав їх, по пʼятдесят чоловік у печері, і годував їх хлібом і водою.
uk.B: Коли Єзавель винищувала пророків {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, Овдій узяв сотню з них і сховав у печерах, по пʼятдесят у кожній, і постачав їм хліб і воду.)
uk.R: Коли цариця Єзавель убивала пророків {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, Овдій узяв сотню з них і сховав у двох печерах, по пʼятдесят у кожній. Він постачав їм їжу і воду.

decisions.choice: cut off: killed, wiped out
decisions.reason: The verb "cut off" is used for destroying people completely (Joshua 23:4). Verse 13 says plainly that Jezebel killed the prophets of Yahweh.

decisions.choice: Jezebel: Ahab's wife, daughter of the king of Sidon
decisions.reason: Ahab married Jezebel, daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and began to serve Baal (16:31). Her persecution of Yahweh's prophets is not told elsewhere; it is known only from this chapter and from 19:10.

decisions.choice: fifty men in a cave: fifty in each of two caves
alternatives: fifty men in one cave (a copying slip for "fifty, fifty")
decisions.reason: Read with verse 13, "fifty, fifty men in a cave", the words mean that the hundred were split into two groups of fifty, each hidden in its own cave.

decisions.choice: bread and water: food and drink
decisions.reason: "Bread" often means food in general. In a time of famine (verse 2), feeding a hundred men in secret was costly as well as dangerous.

decisions.choice: Queen Jezebel; two caves, fifty in each
decisions.reason: Readable says who Jezebel was and spells out the two caves.

decisions.choice: Jezebel "ईज़ेबेल"; prophets "भविष्यद्वक्ता" (L, B), "नबी" (R)
decisions.reason: "ईज़ेबेल" as the history terms note and Revelation 2:20; the prophet pair as the style guide and Romans 11:3 ("तेरे भविष्यद्वक्ताओं" / "तेरे नबियों").

decisions.choice: "Иезавель"
decisions.reason: The form of Revelation 2:20 and of the history terms note.

decisions.choice: parentheses around 18:3b-4
decisions.reason: The Balanced level marks the aside about Obadiah with brackets, as the English does.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ אֶל־עֹ֣בַדְיָ֔הוּ לֵ֤ךְ בָּאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶל־כָּל־מַעְיְנֵ֣י הַמַּ֔יִם וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־הַנְּחָלִ֑ים אוּלַ֣י׀נִמְצָ֣א חָצִ֗יר וּנְחַיֶּה֙ ס֣וּס וָפֶ֔רֶד וְל֥וֹא נַכְרִ֖ית מֵהַבְּהֵמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Ahab to Obadiah, Go through the land to all [the] springs of the water and to all the wadis; perhaps we will find grass and keep alive horse and mule, and not cut off from the livestock.

en.L: And Ahab said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to all the springs of water and to all the wadis. Perhaps we will find grass and keep alive horse and mule, and we will not cut off [any] of the livestock."
en.B: Ahab said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to every spring and every stream bed. Perhaps we can find grass and keep the horses and mules alive, and not have to destroy any of our animals."
en.R: Ahab told Obadiah, "Go all through the land. Look at every spring of water and every valley where a stream runs. Maybe we can find some grass so we can keep our horses and mules alive. Then we will not have to kill any of our animals."

es.L: Y Acab dijo a Abdías: «Recorre la tierra, a todas las fuentes de agua y a todos los torrentes. Quizá hallemos hierba y conservemos vivos el caballo y la mula, y no tengamos que eliminar [nada] del ganado».
es.B: Acab le dijo a Abdías: «Recorre el país, ve a cada fuente y a cada cauce de arroyo. Quizá encontremos hierba y podamos mantener vivos a los caballos y las mulas, y no tengamos que sacrificar a ninguno de nuestros animales».
es.R: Acab le dijo a Abdías: «Recorre todo el país. Busca en cada fuente de agua y en cada valle por donde corre un arroyo. Tal vez encontremos algo de hierba para mantener vivos a nuestros caballos y mulas. Así no tendremos que matar a ninguno de nuestros animales».

fr.L: Et Achab dit à Abdias : « Va par le pays vers toutes les sources d’eau et vers tous les torrents. Peut-être trouverons-nous de l’herbe, et garderons-nous en vie cheval et mulet, et nous n’aurons pas à retrancher [une partie] du bétail. »
fr.B: Achab dit à Abdias : « Parcours le pays, va voir toutes les sources et tous les lits de torrents. Peut-être trouverons-nous de l’herbe pour garder en vie les chevaux et les mulets, et n’aurons-nous pas à abattre une partie de nos bêtes. »
fr.R: Achab a dit à Abdias : « Parcours tout le pays. Va voir chaque source et chaque vallée où coule un ruisseau. Peut-être que nous trouverons un peu d’herbe pour garder en vie nos chevaux et nos mulets. Alors nous n’aurons pas à tuer une partie de nos bêtes. »

sw.L: Ahabu akamwambia Obadia, "Pita katika nchi, kwenye chemchemi zote za maji na kwenye vijito vyote. Huenda tukapata majani, tukawahifadhi hai farasi na nyumbu, wala tusikatilie mbali [wowote] wa mifugo."
sw.B: Ahabu akamwambia Obadia, "Pita katika nchi yote, kwenye kila chemchemi na kila mkondo wa kijito. Huenda tukapata majani tukawaweka hai farasi na nyumbu, tusilazimike kuchinja wanyama wetu wowote."
sw.R: Ahabu akamwambia Obadia, "Zunguka katika nchi yote. Angalia kila chemchemi ya maji na kila bonde lenye kijito. Labda tutapata majani ili tuwaweke hai farasi na nyumbu wetu. Ndipo hatutalazimika kuua wanyama wetu wowote."

vi.L: A-háp nói với Áp-đia: "Hãy đi khắp xứ, đến mọi nguồn nước và mọi khe suối; may ra chúng ta tìm được cỏ để giữ cho ngựa và la sống, và không phải giết bớt [con nào] trong đàn gia súc."
vi.B: A-háp bảo Áp-đia: "Hãy đi khắp xứ, đến mọi nguồn nước và mọi lòng khe. May ra chúng ta tìm được cỏ để giữ cho ngựa và la sống, khỏi phải giết bớt gia súc."
vi.R: A-háp bảo Áp-đia: "Hãy đi khắp xứ. Hãy tìm ở mọi suối nước và mọi thung lũng có dòng nước chảy. May ra chúng ta tìm được ít cỏ để giữ cho ngựa và la của chúng ta sống. Như vậy chúng ta khỏi phải giết con thú nào."

ko.L: 그리고 아합이 오바댜에게 말했다. "이 땅을 두루 다니며 모든 물 샘과 모든 시내로 가 보아라. 혹시 풀을 찾으면 말과 노새를 살릴 수 있고, 가축을 하나도 잃지 않을 것이다."
ko.B: 아합이 오바댜에게 말했다. "온 땅을 두루 다니며 모든 샘과 모든 시냇가를 살펴보아라. 혹시 풀을 찾으면 말과 노새를 살릴 수 있을 것이고, 가축을 하나도 잡지 않아도 될 것이다."
ko.R: 아합이 오바댜에게 말했다. "온 땅을 두루 다녀 보아라. 물이 나오는 샘과 시냇물이 흐르는 골짜기를 모두 살펴보아라. 혹시 풀을 찾으면 우리 말과 노새를 살릴 수 있을 것이다. 그러면 가축을 한 마리도 죽이지 않아도 된다."

pt.L: E Acabe disse a Obadias: "Vá pela terra a todas as fontes de água e a todos os ribeiros. Talvez encontremos capim e conservemos com vida cavalos e mulas, e não tenhamos de exterminar [nenhum] dos animais."
pt.B: Acabe disse a Obadias: "Percorra a terra e vá a todas as fontes e a todos os leitos de riachos. Talvez encontremos capim para manter vivos os cavalos e as mulas, e não tenhamos de abater nenhum dos nossos animais."
pt.R: Acabe disse a Obadias: "Percorra toda a terra. Procure em todas as fontes de água e em todos os vales onde corre um riacho. Talvez encontremos algum capim para manter vivos os nossos cavalos e as nossas mulas. Assim não vamos ter de matar nenhum dos nossos animais."

am.L: አክዓብም አብድዩን አለው፦ «በምድሪቱ ወደ ውኃ ምንጮች ሁሉ፣ ወደ ወንዝ ሸለቆዎችም ሁሉ ሂድ፤ ምናልባት ሣር እናገኝ ይሆናል፤ ፈረሱንና በቅሎውንም በሕይወት እናቆያለን፤ ከከብቶቹም አንዳች አናጠፋም።»
am.B: አክዓብ አብድዩን እንዲህ አለው፦ «በምድሪቱ ወዳሉት ምንጮችና የወንዝ ሸለቆዎች ሁሉ ሂድ። ምናልባት ሣር አግኝተን ፈረሶቹንና በቅሎዎቹን በሕይወት እናቆይ ይሆናል፤ ከእንስሶቻችንም አንዱንም ማጥፋት አያስፈልገንም።»
am.R: አክዓብ አብድዩን እንዲህ አለው፦ «በምድሪቱ ሁሉ ዙር። የውኃ ምንጮችንና ጅረት የሚፈስባቸውን ሸለቆዎች ሁሉ ተመልከት። ፈረሶቻችንንና በቅሎዎቻችንን በሕይወት የምናቆይበት ጥቂት ሣር ምናልባት እናገኝ ይሆናል። እንዲህ ከሆነ ከእንስሶቻችን አንዱንም መግደል አያስፈልገንም።»

hi.L: और अहाब ने ओबद्याह से कहा, "देश में पानी के सब सोतों और सब नालों के पास जाओ। शायद हमें घास मिल जाए, और हम घोड़ों और खच्चरों को जीवित रख सकें, और हमें पशुओं में से [किसी को] नष्ट न करना पड़े।"
hi.B: अहाब ने ओबद्याह से कहा, "देश में घूमकर हर सोते और हर नाले के पास जाओ। शायद हमें घास मिल जाए और हम घोड़ों और खच्चरों को जीवित रख सकें, और हमें अपने किसी भी पशु को मारना न पड़े।"
hi.R: अहाब ने ओबद्याह से कहा, "सारे देश में घूमो। पानी के हर सोते को और हर उस घाटी को देखो जिसमें नाला बहता है। शायद हमें कुछ घास मिल जाए, ताकि हम अपने घोड़ों और खच्चरों को ज़िंदा रख सकें। तब हमें अपने किसी भी जानवर को मारना नहीं पड़ेगा।"

ru.L: И сказал Ахав Авдию: «Пройди по земле ко всем источникам вод и ко всем потокам: может быть, найдём траву и сохраним в живых коней и мулов, и не придётся нам истреблять скот.»
ru.B: Ахав сказал Авдию: «Пройди по стране ко всем источникам и ко всем руслам потоков. Может быть, мы найдём траву и сохраним коней и мулов, и нам не придётся забивать скот.»
ru.R: Ахав сказал Авдию: «Пройди по всей стране. Осмотри каждый источник воды и каждую долину, где течёт ручей. Может быть, мы найдём немного травы, чтобы наши кони и мулы остались живы. Тогда нам не придётся убивать наш скот.»

uk.L: І сказав Ахав Овдієві: «Іди по краю до всіх джерел води і до всіх потоків; може, знайдемо траву і збережемо живими коня й мула, і не винищимо [нічого] з худоби».
uk.B: Ахав сказав Овдієві: «Пройди по краю до кожного джерела і до кожного русла потоку. Може, ми знайдемо траву і збережемо живими коней і мулів, і не доведеться знищувати нашої худоби».
uk.R: Ахав сказав Овдієві: «Пройди всім краєм. Оглянь кожне джерело і кожну долину, де тече потік. Може, ми знайдемо трохи трави, щоб зберегти живими наших коней і мулів. Тоді нам не доведеться вбивати нашої худоби».

decisions.choice: wadis: stream beds that hold water in the rainy season
decisions.reason: A wadi is a valley with a stream that may run dry in summer. In the drought, the last green grass would be near springs and in the beds of such streams.

decisions.choice: horses and mules: the king's chariot and riding animals
decisions.reason: Ahab had a large chariot force (22:34; compare 10:26). Losing the horses would weaken the kingdom's army. The singular words are used for the whole kind of animal.

decisions.choice: not cut off any of the livestock: not have to lose or slaughter any animals
alternatives: not lose any animals to the famine
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for Jezebel's killing of the prophets in verse 4. The king is anxious to cut off none of his animals while his queen cuts off Yahweh's prophets.

decisions.choice: stream bed (Balanced); valley where a stream runs (Readable); our animals
decisions.reason: "Wadi" is not a common English word, so Balanced and Readable describe it.

decisions.choice: exterminar (also verse 4)
decisions.reason: Literal uses the same verb, "exterminar", for the king's animals here and for Jezebel's prophets in verse 4, so the reader sees the contrast the Hebrew draws with one verb (m3); Balanced and Readable say what it means for animals, "abater" and "matar".

decisions.choice: Ahab says "तुम" to Obadiah, his steward
decisions.reason: A king to his official, as David to his servants in 2 Samuel.

source.text: וַֽיְחַלְּק֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לַֽעֲבָר־בָּ֑הּ אַחְאָ֞ב הָלַ֨ךְ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ לְבַדּ֔וֹ וְעֹֽבַדְיָ֛הוּ הָלַ֥ךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ־אֶחָ֖ד לְבַדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they divided to themselves the land to pass through it; Ahab went in way one by himself, and Obadiah went in way one by himself.

en.L: And they divided the land between them to pass through it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
en.B: So they divided the land between them to cover it, Ahab going one way on his own and Obadiah another way on his own.
en.R: So they split up the land to search all of it. Ahab went one way alone, and Obadiah went the other way alone.

es.L: Y se repartieron la tierra para recorrerla: Acab fue por un camino solo, y Abdías fue por otro camino solo.
es.B: Así que se repartieron el país para recorrerlo; Acab se fue por un camino él solo, y Abdías por otro él solo.
es.R: Así que se dividieron el país para buscar por todas partes. Acab se fue solo por un camino, y Abdías se fue solo por el otro.

fr.L: Et ils se partagèrent le pays pour le parcourir : Achab alla seul par un chemin, et Abdias alla seul par un autre chemin.
fr.B: Ils se partagèrent donc le pays pour le parcourir, Achab partant seul d’un côté et Abdias seul de l’autre.
fr.R: Ils se sont donc partagé le pays pour le fouiller en entier. Achab est parti seul d’un côté, et Abdias seul de l’autre.

sw.L: Wakaigawanya nchi kati yao ili kuipita: Ahabu akaenda njia moja peke yake, na Obadia akaenda njia nyingine peke yake.
sw.B: Basi wakaigawanya nchi kati yao ili waipitie yote, Ahabu akienda njia moja peke yake na Obadia njia nyingine peke yake.
sw.R: Basi wakaigawanya nchi ili waitafute yote. Ahabu akaenda njia moja peke yake, na Obadia akaenda njia nyingine peke yake.

vi.L: Họ chia đất giữa hai người để đi khắp; A-háp đi một đường riêng, và Áp-đia đi một đường khác riêng.
vi.B: Vậy họ chia nhau vùng đất để đi khắp; A-háp tự đi một ngả, Áp-đia tự đi một ngả khác.
vi.R: Vậy họ chia nhau đi tìm khắp xứ. A-háp đi một mình một ngả, còn Áp-đia đi một mình ngả kia.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 땅을 두루 다니려고 그것을 나누었다. 아합은 홀로 한 길로 가고, 오바댜는 홀로 다른 길로 갔다.
ko.B: 그래서 그들은 온 땅을 살피려고 땅을 나누었다. 아합은 혼자서 한쪽 길로 가고, 오바댜는 혼자서 다른 쪽 길로 갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 그들은 온 땅을 다 찾아보려고 땅을 나누었다. 아합은 혼자 한쪽으로 가고, 오바댜는 혼자 다른 쪽으로 갔다.

pt.L: E repartiram entre si a terra para percorrê-la: Acabe foi por um caminho, sozinho, e Obadias foi por outro caminho, sozinho.
pt.B: Então dividiram a terra entre eles para percorrê-la: Acabe foi sozinho por um caminho, e Obadias foi sozinho por outro.
pt.R: Então eles dividiram a terra para procurar em toda parte. Acabe foi sozinho para um lado, e Obadias foi sozinho para o outro.

am.L: ያልፉባትም ዘንድ ምድሪቱን በመካከላቸው ተካፈሉ፤ አክዓብ ብቻውን በአንድ መንገድ ሄደ፤ አብድዩም ብቻውን በሌላ መንገድ ሄደ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ለማዳረስ በመካከላቸው ተከፋፈሉ፤ አክዓብ ለብቻው በአንድ መንገድ፣ አብድዩም ለብቻው በሌላ መንገድ ሄዱ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ለመፈለግ ተከፋፈሉ። አክዓብ ብቻውን በአንድ በኩል ሄደ፤ አብድዩም ብቻውን በሌላ በኩል ሄደ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने देश को उसमें से होकर जाने के लिए आपस में बाँट लिया: अहाब अकेला एक मार्ग से गया, और ओबद्याह अकेला दूसरे मार्ग से गया।
hi.B: तब उन्होंने सारे देश को छान मारने के लिए उसे आपस में बाँट लिया; अहाब अकेला एक ओर गया और ओबद्याह अकेला दूसरी ओर।
hi.R: तब उन्होंने सारा देश खोजने के लिए उसे आपस में बाँट लिया। अहाब अकेला एक ओर गया, और ओबद्याह अकेला दूसरी ओर।

ru.L: И разделили они между собой землю, чтобы пройти её: Ахав пошёл одной дорогой отдельно, и Авдий пошёл другой дорогой отдельно.
ru.B: Они разделили между собой страну, чтобы обойти её: Ахав пошёл в одну сторону сам, а Авдий в другую сам.
ru.R: Они разделили страну между собой, чтобы осмотреть её всю. Ахав пошёл в одну сторону один, а Авдий в другую тоже один.

uk.L: І поділили вони між собою край, щоб пройти його: Ахав пішов однією дорогою сам, а Овдій пішов іншою дорогою сам.
uk.B: Тож вони поділили між собою край, щоб обійти його: Ахав пішов сам в один бік, а Овдій сам в інший.
uk.R: Тож вони поділили край, щоб обшукати його весь. Ахав пішов сам в один бік, а Овдій сам у другий.

decisions.choice: Ahab went ... Obadiah went: the king himself searches
decisions.reason: The word order puts the two men side by side. That the king goes out himself shows how desperate the famine had become.

decisions.choice: another way
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "one way ... one way"; English says "one way ... another way".

source.text: וַיְהִ֤י עֹבַדְיָ֨הוּ֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְהִנֵּ֥ה אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ לִקְרָאת֑וֹ וַיַּכִּרֵ֨הוּ֙ וַיִּפֹּ֣ל עַל־פָּנָ֔יו וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הַאַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה אֲדֹנִ֥י אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And was Obadiah on the way, and there! Elijah to meet him; and he recognized him and fell on his face and said, [Is] this you, my lord Elijah?

en.L: And Obadiah was on the way, and look, Elijah [was coming] to meet him. And he recognized him and fell on his face and said, "[Is] it you, my lord Elijah?"
en.B: As Obadiah was on his way, there was Elijah coming to meet him. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down with his face to the ground, and said, "Is it really you, my lord Elijah?"
en.R: While Obadiah was on the road, suddenly Elijah was there, coming toward him. Obadiah knew who he was. He bowed down low with his face to the ground and said, "Is that you, my master Elijah?"

es.L: Y estando Abdías en el camino, he aquí que Elías [venía] a su encuentro. Y lo reconoció y cayó sobre su rostro y dijo: «¿[Eres] tú, mi señor Elías?».
es.B: Mientras Abdías iba por el camino, Elías le salió al encuentro. Abdías lo reconoció, se inclinó rostro en tierra y dijo: «¿De verdad eres tú, mi señor Elías?».
es.R: Mientras Abdías iba por el camino, de pronto apareció Elías, que venía hacia él. Abdías supo quién era. Se inclinó con el rostro en tierra y dijo: «¿Eres tú, mi señor Elías?».

fr.L: Et Abdias était en chemin, et voici, Élie [venait] à sa rencontre. Et il le reconnut, tomba sur sa face et dit : « [Est-ce] toi, mon seigneur Élie ? »
fr.B: Comme Abdias était en chemin, voici qu’Élie vint à sa rencontre. Abdias le reconnut, se prosterna le visage contre terre et dit : « Est-ce bien toi, mon seigneur Élie ? »
fr.R: Pendant qu’Abdias était en route, tout à coup Élie s’est trouvé là, venant vers lui. Abdias l’a reconnu. Il s’est prosterné, le visage contre terre, et il a dit : « C’est toi, mon maître Élie ? »

sw.L: Obadia alipokuwa njiani, tazama, Eliya [akaja] kumlaki. Akamtambua, akaanguka kifudifudi, akasema, "Je, ni wewe, bwana wangu Eliya?"
sw.B: Obadia alipokuwa njiani, mara Eliya akaja kukutana naye. Obadia akamtambua, akainama uso wake mpaka chini, akasema, "Je, ni wewe kweli, bwana wangu Eliya?"
sw.R: Obadia alipokuwa barabarani, ghafla Eliya alitokea akija upande wake. Obadia akamtambua. Akainama mpaka uso wake ukagusa ardhi, akasema, "Je, ni wewe, bwana wangu Eliya?"

vi.L: Áp-đia đang đi trên đường, kìa, Ê-li [đến] gặp ông. Ông nhận ra Ê-li, sấp mặt xuống đất và nói: "[Có phải] chính ông, chúa tôi Ê-li đó không?"
vi.B: Áp-đia đang đi trên đường thì gặp Ê-li đi đến. Áp-đia nhận ra ông, liền sấp mặt xuống đất và nói: "Có thật là ông không, thưa chúa tôi Ê-li?"
vi.R: Áp-đia đang đi trên đường thì bỗng thấy Ê-li đi về phía mình. Áp-đia nhận ra ông. Ông cúi sấp mặt xuống đất và nói: "Có phải ông đó không, thưa thầy Ê-li?"

ko.L: 그리고 오바댜가 길에 있는데, 보라, 엘리야가 그를 맞으러 [왔다]. 그가 그를 알아보고 얼굴을 땅에 대고 엎드려 말했다. "내 주 엘리야여, 당신이십니까?"
ko.B: 오바댜가 길을 가는데, 마침 엘리야가 그에게로 오고 있었다. 오바댜는 그를 알아보고 얼굴을 땅에 대고 엎드려 말했다. "내 주 엘리야여, 정말 당신이십니까?"
ko.R: 오바댜가 길을 가는데, 갑자기 엘리야가 그에게로 다가왔다. 오바댜는 그를 알아보았다. 그는 얼굴을 땅에 대고 엎드려 말했다. "엘리야 어른, 정말 당신이십니까?"

pt.L: E Obadias estava no caminho, e eis que Elias [vinha] ao seu encontro. E ele o reconheceu, e caiu sobre o seu rosto, e disse: "[É] o senhor, meu senhor Elias?"
pt.B: Enquanto Obadias seguia pelo caminho, Elias apareceu, vindo ao seu encontro. Obadias o reconheceu, prostrou-se com o rosto em terra e disse: "É o senhor mesmo, meu senhor Elias?"
pt.R: Obadias estava na estrada quando, de repente, Elias apareceu, vindo na direção dele. Obadias o reconheceu. Ele se curvou com o rosto no chão e disse: "É o senhor mesmo, senhor Elias?"

am.L: አብድዩም በመንገድ ሳለ፣ እነሆ፣ ኤልያስ ሊገናኘው [መጣ]፤ እርሱም አወቀው፤ በግንባሩም ተደፍቶ፦ «ጌታዬ ኤልያስ፣ ይህ እርስዎ ነዎትን?» አለ።
am.B: አብድዩ በመንገድ ሲሄድ ኤልያስ ሊገናኘው ሲመጣ አገኘው። አብድዩም አውቆት በግንባሩ ወደ መሬት ተደፍቶ፦ «ጌታዬ ኤልያስ፣ በእውነት እርስዎ ነዎትን?» አለ።
am.R: አብድዩ በመንገድ ላይ ሳለ ድንገት ኤልያስ ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አየ። አብድዩም ማን እንደ ሆነ አወቀ። ፊቱን ወደ መሬት አድርጎ ዝቅ ብሎ ሰገደና፦ «ጌታዬ ኤልያስ፣ እርስዎ ነዎት?» አለ።

hi.L: और ओबद्याह मार्ग में था, और देखो, एलिय्याह उससे मिलने [आ रहा था]। और उसने उसे पहचान लिया और मुँह के बल गिरकर कहा, "क्या आप [ही] हैं, मेरे स्वामी एलिय्याह?"
hi.B: जब ओबद्याह मार्ग में था, तब एलिय्याह उससे मिलने सामने आ गया। ओबद्याह ने उसे पहचान लिया, और भूमि तक मुँह के बल झुककर कहा, "मेरे स्वामी एलिय्याह, क्या सचमुच आप हैं?"
hi.R: ओबद्याह रास्ते में था कि अचानक एलिय्याह सामने से उसकी ओर आता दिखाई दिया। ओबद्याह ने उसे पहचान लिया। उसने ज़मीन तक मुँह झुकाकर प्रणाम किया और कहा, "मेरे मालिक एलिय्याह, क्या यह आप हैं?"

ru.L: И был Авдий в пути, и вот, Илия [идёт] навстречу ему. И узнал он его, и пал на лицо своё, и сказал: «Ты ли это, господин мой Илия?»
ru.B: Когда Авдий был в пути, ему навстречу вышел Илия. Авдий узнал его, поклонился до земли и сказал: «Неужели это ты, господин мой Илия?»
ru.R: Авдий шёл по дороге, и вдруг ему навстречу вышел Илия. Авдий узнал его, низко поклонился до самой земли и сказал: «Это ты, мой господин Илия?»

uk.L: І був Овдій у дорозі, і ось Ілля [йде] йому назустріч. І впізнав він його, і впав на своє обличчя, і сказав: «Чи це ти, мій пане Іллє?»
uk.B: Коли Овдій був у дорозі, назустріч йому вийшов Ілля. Овдій упізнав його, вклонився обличчям до землі і сказав: «Невже це ти, мій пане Іллє?»
uk.R: Коли Овдій ішов дорогою, раптом перед ним опинився Ілля, що йшов йому назустріч. Овдій упізнав його. Він низько вклонився обличчям до землі і сказав: «Це ти, мій пане Іллє?»

decisions.choice: there!: a sudden, unexpected sight
decisions.reason: The word points to something seen at that moment, often with surprise.

decisions.choice: fell on his face: bowed to the ground in deep respect
decisions.reason: Obadiah, the king's high official, bows before the prophet as before a superior and calls him "my lord".

decisions.choice: is it you?: surprise rather than doubt
decisions.reason: Obadiah recognized Elijah, so the question expresses astonishment at finding the man the king had searched for (verse 10).

decisions.choice: look (Literal); there was (Balanced); suddenly (Readable); my master (Readable)
decisions.reason: English has no single word for the Hebrew pointing word. Readable uses "master" so that "lord" is not read as a title for God.

decisions.choice: "mi señor Elías" at every level; "tú"
decisions.reason: Obadiah honors the prophet as the king's subjects honor the king: "mi señor" with "tú", as the Samuel note sets for Spanish; Readable keeps "mi señor" where the English says "my master".

decisions.choice: Obadiah says "tu" to Elijah, with "mon seigneur" (L, B), "mon maître" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: one person is "tu" at every level; respect is carried by the title and by "ton serviteur".

decisions.choice: Obadiah to Elijah: "chúa tôi" (L, B); "thầy" (R); himself "đầy tớ ông"
decisions.reason: Obadiah honours the prophet as his lord; Readable uses "thầy", the respectful word for a man of God, as the English Readable says "my master". Elijah calls him "ông".

decisions.choice: Obadiah speaks to Elijah in 합쇼체, calling him "내 주" (L, B), "엘리야 어른" (R), and himself "당신의 종" (L, B), "저" (R); Elijah answers in 하오체
decisions.reason: The king's steward honors the prophet as his lord; Elijah answers him with the courtesy he shows Ahab. "어른" is the Readable address the Korean Samuel uses for Samuel.

decisions.choice: o senhor; meu senhor Elias (L, B), senhor Elias (R); o seu servo (verses 9, 12)
decisions.reason: Obadiah bows to Elijah as to a superior and calls him "my lord" (m2), so he speaks to him with "o senhor" through verse 14, and of himself as "o seu servo". Readable says "senhor Elias" for the English "my master", since "mestre" would make Elijah a teacher. Elijah answers with "você".

decisions.choice: "ጌታዬ ኤልያስ" with "እርስዎ", and "ባሪያዎ" (Literal) / "አገልጋይዎ" (Balanced, Readable) for "your servant" (verses 9, 12); Elijah answers with "አንተ" and speaks of Ahab as "ጌታህ"
decisions.reason: Obadiah bows to the ground and calls himself Elijah's servant: the courtly third person of the Hebrew is the respectful -ዎ of Amharic, as the terms list sets for a servant before his lord.

decisions.choice: Obadiah says "आप" and "मेरे स्वामी" (L, B), "मेरे मालिक" (R) to Elijah; Elijah says "तुम" to him
decisions.reason: Obadiah honours the prophet as a servant honours a lord (meaning m2: he falls on his face) and calls himself "आपका दास" (18:9, 12). "मेरे स्वामी" stays for Ahab when Elijah speaks of "your lord" (18:8).

decisions.choice: "господин мой Илия" with ты
decisions.reason: Obadiah's respect is carried by "господин мой", as courtly address is in the history books in this translation; Russian ты stays.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ אָ֑נִי לֵ֛ךְ אֱמֹ֥ר לַאדֹנֶ֖יךָ הִנֵּ֥ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to him, I; go, say to your lord, Here [is] Elijah.

en.L: And he said to him, "I [am]. Go, say to your lord, 'Here [is] Elijah.'"
en.B: He answered him, "It is. Go and tell your master, 'Elijah is here.'"
en.R: Elijah said, "Yes, it is me. Go and tell your master, 'Elijah is here.'"

es.L: Y él le dijo: «Yo [soy]. Ve, di a tu señor: “He aquí Elías”».
es.B: Él le respondió: «Sí, soy yo. Ve y dile a tu señor: “Elías está aquí”».
es.R: Elías le dijo: «Sí, soy yo. Ve y dile a tu señor: “Elías está aquí”».

fr.L: Et il lui dit : « [C’est] moi. Va, dis à ton seigneur : “Voici Élie.” »
fr.B: Il lui répondit : « C’est moi. Va dire à ton maître : “Élie est ici.” »
fr.R: Élie a répondu : « Oui, c’est moi. Va dire à ton maître : “Élie est ici.” »

sw.L: Akamwambia, "Ni mimi. Nenda, umwambie bwana wako, 'Eliya [yuko] hapa.'"
sw.B: Akamjibu, "Ndimi. Nenda umwambie bwana wako, 'Eliya yuko hapa.'"
sw.R: Eliya akasema, "Ndiyo, ni mimi. Nenda umwambie bwana wako, 'Eliya yuko hapa.'"

vi.L: Ông nói với Áp-đia: "[Phải,] tôi. Hãy đi nói với chúa của ông: 'Có Ê-li đây.'"
vi.B: Ê-li đáp: "Phải, tôi đây. Hãy đi báo với chủ ông: 'Ê-li đang ở đây.'"
vi.R: Ê-li nói: "Phải, chính tôi. Hãy đi báo với chủ ông: 'Ê-li đang ở đây.'"

ko.L: 그러자 그가 그에게 말했다. "나요. 가서 당신 주인에게 '엘리야가 여기 있습니다' 하고 말하시오."
ko.B: 엘리야가 그에게 대답했다. "그렇소. 가서 당신 주인에게 '엘리야가 여기 있습니다' 하고 알리시오."
ko.R: 엘리야가 말했다. "그렇소, 나요. 가서 당신 주인에게 '엘리야가 여기 있습니다' 하고 전하시오."

pt.L: E ele lhe disse: "[Sou] eu. Vá, diga ao seu senhor: 'Eis [aqui] Elias.'"
pt.B: Ele lhe respondeu: "Sou eu. Vá dizer ao seu amo: 'Elias está aqui.'"
pt.R: Elias disse: "Sim, sou eu. Vá dizer ao seu amo: 'Elias está aqui.'"

am.L: እርሱም፦ «እኔ [ነኝ]፤ ሂድ፤ ለጌታህ፦ “እነሆ፣ ኤልያስ [አለ]” በል» አለው።
am.B: እርሱም፦ «አዎ፣ እኔ ነኝ። ሂድና ለጌታህ “ኤልያስ እዚህ አለ” ብለህ ንገረው» ብሎ መለሰለት።
am.R: ኤልያስም፦ «አዎ፣ እኔ ነኝ። ሂድና ለጌታህ “ኤልያስ እዚህ አለ” ብለህ ንገረው» አለው።

hi.L: और उसने उससे कहा, "[मैं ही] हूँ। जाकर अपने स्वामी से कहो, 'देखिए, एलिय्याह [यहाँ है]।'"
hi.B: उसने उसे उत्तर दिया, "हाँ, मैं ही हूँ। जाकर अपने स्वामी से कहो, 'एलिय्याह यहाँ है।'"
hi.R: एलिय्याह ने कहा, "हाँ, मैं ही हूँ। जाकर अपने मालिक से कहो, 'एलिय्याह यहाँ है।'"

ru.L: И сказал он ему: «Я. Иди, скажи твоему господину: “Вот Илия.”»
ru.B: Тот ответил ему: «Да, я. Иди и скажи своему господину: “Илия здесь.”»
ru.R: Илия сказал: «Да, это я. Иди и скажи своему господину: “Илия здесь.”»

uk.L: І сказав він йому: «Я. Іди, скажи своєму панові: “Ось Ілля”».
uk.B: Той відповів йому: «Я. Іди і скажи своєму панові: “Ілля тут”».
uk.R: Ілля сказав: «Так, це я. Іди і скажи своєму панові: “Ілля тут”».

decisions.choice: your lord: Ahab
decisions.reason: Obadiah has called Elijah "my lord" (verse 7); Elijah points him back to the master he actually serves, the king. The form is plural, a plural of majesty often used for a master.

decisions.choice: your master (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "master" here and in verses 10-14, so the reader can tell Obadiah's master Ahab from Yahweh.

decisions.choice: o seu senhor (L); o seu amo (B, R) for Ahab, through verse 14
decisions.reason: Obadiah's master Ahab (m1) is "o seu senhor" at Literal, as the Hebrew says. Balanced and Readable say "amo", the Portuguese word for a servant's master, so that he is not confused with the LORD nor with Elijah, whom Obadiah calls "o senhor"; the English uses "master" for the same reason.

source.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה חָטָ֑אתִי כִּֽי־אַתָּ֞ה נֹתֵ֧ן אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֛ בְּיַד־אַחְאָ֖ב לַהֲמִיתֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, What have I sinned, that you [are] giving your servant into [the] hand of Ahab to put me to death?

en.L: And he said, "What have I sinned, that you [are] giving your servant into the hand of Ahab to put me to death?
en.B: Obadiah said, "What sin have I committed, that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to be put to death?
en.R: But Obadiah said, "What wrong have I done? Why are you handing your servant over to Ahab? He will kill me!

es.L: Y él dijo: «¿En qué he pecado, para que entregues a tu siervo en mano de Acab para que me mate?
es.B: Abdías dijo: «¿Qué pecado he cometido, para que entregues a tu siervo en manos de Acab para que me mate?
es.R: Pero Abdías dijo: «¿Qué mal he hecho? ¿Por qué quieres entregar a tu siervo en manos de Acab? ¡Él me matará!

fr.L: Et il dit : « Quel péché ai-je commis, pour que tu livres ton serviteur dans la main d’Achab pour me faire mourir ?
fr.B: Abdias reprit : « Quel péché ai-je commis, pour que tu livres ton serviteur à Achab, qui me fera mourir ?
fr.R: Mais Abdias a dit : « Qu’est-ce que j’ai fait de mal ? Pourquoi livres-tu ton serviteur à Achab ? Il va me tuer !

sw.L: Akasema, "Nimetenda dhambi gani, hata wewe [unamtia] mtumishi wako mkononi mwa Ahabu ili aniue?
sw.B: Obadia akasema, "Nimetenda dhambi gani hata unamtia mtumishi wako mikononi mwa Ahabu ili niuawe?
sw.R: Lakini Obadia akasema, "Nimekosa nini? Kwa nini unamtia mtumishi wako mikononi mwa Ahabu? Ataniua!

vi.L: Áp-đia nói: "Tôi đã phạm tội gì mà ông lại phó đầy tớ ông vào tay A-háp để giết tôi?
vi.B: Áp-đia nói: "Tôi đã phạm tội gì mà ông lại giao đầy tớ ông vào tay A-háp để bị giết?
vi.R: Nhưng Áp-đia nói: "Tôi đã làm gì sai? Sao ông lại giao đầy tớ của ông cho A-háp? Vua sẽ giết tôi!

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "제가 무슨 죄를 지었기에 당신은 당신의 종을 아합의 손에 넘겨 저를 죽이게 하려고 하십니까?
ko.B: 오바댜가 말했다. "제가 무슨 죄를 지었다고 당신의 종을 아합의 손에 넘겨 죽게 하려고 하십니까?
ko.R: 그러나 오바댜가 말했다. "제가 무슨 잘못을 했습니까? 왜 저를 아합에게 넘기려고 하십니까? 그는 저를 죽일 것입니다!

pt.L: E ele disse: "Em que pequei, para que o senhor entregue o seu servo na mão de Acabe, para me matar?
pt.B: Obadias disse: "Que pecado cometi, para que o senhor entregue o seu servo a Acabe para ser morto?
pt.R: Mas Obadias disse: "Que mal eu fiz? Por que o senhor está entregando o seu servo a Acabe? Ele vai me matar!

am.L: እርሱም አለ፦ «ይገድለኝ ዘንድ ባሪያዎን በአክዓብ እጅ አሳልፈው የሚሰጡት ምን ኃጢአት ሠርቼ ነው?
am.B: አብድዩም እንዲህ አለ፦ «አገልጋይዎን እንዲገድለኝ ለአክዓብ አሳልፈው የሚሰጡኝ ምን ኃጢአት ሠርቼ ነው?
am.R: አብድዩ ግን እንዲህ አለ፦ «ምን በደል አደረግኩ? ለምን አገልጋይዎን ለአክዓብ አሳልፈው ይሰጣሉ? እርሱ ይገድለኛል!

hi.L: और उसने कहा, "मैंने क्या पाप किया है कि आप अपने दास को अहाब के हाथ में दे रहे हैं कि वह मुझे मार डाले?
hi.B: ओबद्याह ने कहा, "मैंने कौन सा पाप किया है कि आप अपने दास को अहाब के हाथ में सौंप रहे हैं, ताकि वह मुझे मरवा डाले?
hi.R: पर ओबद्याह ने कहा, "मैंने क्या ग़लती की है? आप अपने दास को अहाब के हाथ में क्यों सौंप रहे हैं? वह तो मुझे मार डालेगा!

ru.L: И сказал он: «Чем я согрешил, что ты отдаёшь твоего раба в руку Ахава, чтобы умертвить меня?
ru.B: Авдий сказал: «Какой грех я совершил, что ты отдаёшь своего раба Ахаву на смерть?
ru.R: Но Авдий сказал: «Что плохого я сделал? Зачем ты отдаёшь своего раба Ахаву? Он убьёт меня!

uk.L: І сказав той: «Чим я згрішив, що ти віддаєш свого раба в руку Ахава, щоб убити мене?
uk.B: Овдій сказав: «Який гріх я вчинив, що ти віддаєш свого слугу Ахавові на смерть?
uk.R: Але Овдій сказав: «Що я зробив поганого? Навіщо ти віддаєш свого слугу Ахавові? Він убʼє мене!

decisions.choice: your servant: Obadiah's polite way of speaking of himself
decisions.reason: Speaking of oneself as "your servant" was a courteous form of address to a superior (Genesis 18:3; 1 Samuel 20:7-8).

decisions.choice: what have I sinned: what wrong have I done to deserve this
decisions.reason: Obadiah does not confess a sin. He protests that he has done nothing to deserve being sent to his death.

decisions.choice: your servant at every level
decisions.reason: Polite self-reference keeps "your servant" at every level, as Genesis 18:3 and 1 Samuel 20 do. Obadiah's speech runs to verse 14, so this record leaves the quotation open.

decisions.choice: "tu siervo" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note sets for Spanish: "tu siervo" is the speaker's polite word for himself at every level.

decisions.choice: "ton serviteur" at every level
decisions.reason: As the English, the polite self-reference is kept at every level here, Readable included.

decisions.choice: mtumishi wako, at every level
decisions.reason: Obadiah's polite "your servant" is "mtumishi wako" at every level, as the Samuel note sets for speech to a superior.

decisions.choice: "आपका दास" / "अपने दास" at every level
decisions.reason: Obadiah's polite way of speaking of himself (meaning m1), kept at every level as the English does.

decisions.choice: "твоего раба" (L); "своего раба" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Self-designation "your servant" as 2 Samuel in this translation; reflexive свой where ты is the subject.

source.text: חַ֣י׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אִם־יֶשׁ־גּ֤וֹי וּמַמְלָכָה֙ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־שָׁלַ֨ח אֲדֹנִ֥י שָׁם֙ לְבַקֶּשְׁךָ֔ וְאָמְר֖וּ אָ֑יִן וְהִשְׁבִּ֤יעַ אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ וְאֶת־הַגּ֔וֹי כִּ֖י לֹ֥א יִמְצָאֶֽכָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: [As] lives Yahweh your God, if there is a nation and kingdom where not has sent my lord there to seek you; and they said, [He is] not [here], and he made swear the kingdom and the nation that not it has found you.

en.L: [As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. And when they said, '[He is] not [here],' he made the kingdom and the nation swear that they had not found you.
en.B: As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God lives, my master has sent people to look for you in every nation and kingdom. Whenever a nation said, 'He is not here,' he made its people swear that they could not find you.
en.R: I promise you, as surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God lives, my master has sent men to every nation and kingdom to look for you. When the people of a nation said, 'He is not here,' Ahab made them swear an oath that they really could not find you.

es.L: Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, que no hay nación ni reino adonde mi señor no haya enviado a buscarte. Y cuando decían: “No [está aquí]”, hacía jurar al reino y a la nación que no te habían hallado.
es.B: Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, mi señor ha enviado a buscarte a todas las naciones y reinos. Y cada vez que una nación decía: “No está aquí”, él hacía jurar a su gente que no te habían encontrado.
es.R: Te lo aseguro, tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, mi señor ha enviado hombres a todas las naciones y reinos a buscarte. Cuando la gente de una nación decía: “No está aquí”, Acab les hacía jurar que de verdad no habían podido encontrarte.

fr.L: [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est vivant, il n’y a pas de nation ni de royaume où mon seigneur n’ait envoyé te chercher. Et quand ils disaient : “[Il n’est] pas [là]”, il faisait jurer le royaume et la nation qu’on ne t’avait pas trouvé.
fr.B: Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est vivant, mon maître a envoyé des gens te chercher dans toutes les nations et tous les royaumes. Chaque fois qu’une nation disait : “Il n’est pas ici”, il faisait jurer à ses habitants qu’on ne t’avait pas trouvé.
fr.R: Je te le jure, aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est vivant : mon maître a envoyé des hommes dans toutes les nations et tous les royaumes pour te chercher. Quand les gens d’un pays disaient : “Il n’est pas ici”, Achab les obligeait à jurer qu’ils n’avaient vraiment pas pu te trouver.

sw.L: Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aishivyo, hakuna taifa wala ufalme ambako bwana wangu hakutuma kukutafuta. Nao waliposema, '[Hayuko hapa],' akaufanya ufalme na taifa kuapa kwamba hawakukuona.
sw.B: Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aishivyo, bwana wangu ametuma watu kukutafuta katika kila taifa na kila ufalme. Kila taifa liliposema, 'Hayuko hapa,' aliwaapisha watu wake kwamba hawakuweza kukuona.
sw.R: Nakuhakikishia, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aishivyo, bwana wangu ametuma watu katika kila taifa na kila ufalme wakutafute. Watu wa taifa fulani waliposema, 'Hayuko hapa,' Ahabu aliwaapisha kwamba kweli hawakuweza kukuona.

vi.L: Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông hằng sống, không có dân tộc hay vương quốc nào mà chúa tôi không sai người đến tìm ông. Khi họ nói: '[Ông ấy] không [có ở đây],' thì vua bắt vương quốc và dân tộc ấy thề rằng họ không tìm thấy ông.
vi.B: Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông hằng sống, chủ tôi đã sai người đi tìm ông khắp mọi dân tộc và vương quốc. Mỗi khi một dân tộc nói: 'Ông ấy không có ở đây,' thì vua bắt dân ấy thề rằng họ thật không tìm thấy ông.
vi.R: Tôi xin thề với ông, thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông hằng sống, chủ tôi đã sai người đến mọi dân tộc và vương quốc để tìm ông. Khi dân của nước nào nói: 'Ông ấy không có ở đây,' thì A-háp bắt họ thề rằng họ thật sự không tìm được ông.

ko.L: 당신의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세합니다. 내 주인이 당신을 찾으려고 사람을 보내지 않은 민족이나 나라가 없습니다. 그들이 '[그는 여기] 없습니다' 하면, 그는 그 나라와 그 민족에게 당신을 찾지 못했다고 맹세하게 했습니다.
ko.B: 당신의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 내 주인은 당신을 찾으려고 모든 민족과 나라에 사람을 보냈습니다. 어느 민족이든 '그는 여기 없습니다' 하고 말하면, 그는 그 나라 사람들에게 당신을 정말 찾지 못했다고 맹세하게 했습니다.
ko.R: 당신의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 제 주인은 당신을 찾으려고 모든 민족과 나라에 사람들을 보냈습니다. 어느 나라 사람들이 '그는 여기 없습니다' 하고 말하면, 아합은 그들에게 정말 당신을 찾지 못했다고 맹세하게 했습니다.

pt.L: [Tão certo como] vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, não há nação nem reino aonde o meu senhor não tenha mandado procurá-lo. E, quando diziam: '[Ele] não [está aqui]', ele fazia o reino e a nação jurar que não o tinham encontrado.
pt.B: Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, o meu amo mandou procurá-lo em todas as nações e reinos. Sempre que uma nação dizia: 'Ele não está aqui', ele fazia o povo dela jurar que não tinha conseguido encontrá-lo.
pt.R: Eu lhe garanto, tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus: o meu amo mandou homens a todas as nações e reinos para procurar o senhor. Quando o povo de uma nação dizia: 'Ele não está aqui', Acabe obrigava o povo a jurar que realmente não tinha conseguido encontrar o senhor.

am.L: አምላክዎ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕያው ነውና፣ ጌታዬ እርስዎን ይፈልግ ዘንድ ያልላከበት ሕዝብ ወይም መንግሥት የለም፤ እነርሱም “[እዚህ] የለም” ባሉ ጊዜ፣ እንዳላገኙዎት መንግሥቱንና ሕዝቡን አስማለ።
am.B: አምላክዎ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕያው ነውና፣ ጌታዬ እርስዎን እንዲፈልጉ ወደ ሕዝብና ወደ መንግሥት ሁሉ ሰዎችን ልኳል። አንድ ሕዝብ “እዚህ የለም” ባለ ጊዜ ሁሉ እንዳላገኙዎት ሰዎቹን ያስምል ነበር።
am.R: ሕያው በሆነው በአምላክዎ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} እምላለሁ፤ ጌታዬ እርስዎን እንዲፈልጉ ወደ ሕዝብና ወደ መንግሥት ሁሉ ሰዎችን ልኳል። የአንድ ሕዝብ ሰዎች “እዚህ የለም” ባሉ ጊዜ አክዓብ በእርግጥ እንዳላገኙዎት በመሐላ እንዲያረጋግጡ ያደርጋቸው ነበር።

hi.L: आपके परमेश्वर, जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ, ऐसी कोई जाति या राज्य नहीं जहाँ मेरे स्वामी ने आपको खोजने के लिए न भेजा हो। और जब वे कहते, '[वह यहाँ] नहीं [है],' तो वह उस राज्य और उस जाति से शपथ खिलवाता कि उन्होंने आपको नहीं पाया।
hi.B: आपके परमेश्वर, जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ, मेरे स्वामी ने हर देश और हर राज्य में आपको खोजने के लिए लोग भेजे हैं। जब किसी देश के लोग कहते, 'वह यहाँ नहीं है,' तो वह उनसे शपथ खिलवाता था कि उन्हें आप नहीं मिले।
hi.R: मैं आपसे सच कहता हूँ, आपके परमेश्वर, जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ, मेरे मालिक ने आपको ढूँढ़ने के लिए हर देश और हर राज्य में आदमी भेजे हैं। जब किसी देश के लोग कहते, 'वह यहाँ नहीं है,' तो अहाब उनसे शपथ खिलवाता था कि उन्हें सचमुच आप नहीं मिले।

ru.L: [Как] жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, нет народа и царства, куда не посылал бы мой господин искать тебя. И когда говорили: “[Его] нет”, он брал клятву с царства и народа, что не нашли тебя.
ru.B: Как верно то, что жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, мой господин посылал людей искать тебя к каждому народу и в каждое царство. И когда там говорили: “Его здесь нет”, он заставлял этот народ клясться, что тебя не нашли.
ru.R: Клянусь тебе, как верно то, что жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, мой господин посылал людей искать тебя ко всем народам и во все царства. И когда люди какого-то народа говорили: “Его здесь нет”, Ахав заставлял их поклясться, что они правда не нашли тебя.

uk.L: [Як] живий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, немає народу чи царства, куди не посилав мій пан шукати тебе. І коли казали: “[Його] немає”, — він заприсягав царство і народ, що не знайшли тебе.
uk.B: Як певно, що живий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, мій пан посилав людей шукати тебе до кожного народу і царства. Щоразу, як народ казав: “Його тут немає”, — він змушував людей присягати, що вони не можуть тебе знайти.
uk.R: Запевняю тебе, як певно, що живий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, мій пан посилав людей до кожного народу і царства шукати тебе. Коли люди якогось народу казали: “Його тут немає”, — Ахав змушував їх присягати, що вони справді не можуть тебе знайти.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh lives: an oath
decisions.reason: The words call on the living God as witness that what follows is true (Judges 8:19; 1 Samuel 14:39).

decisions.choice: if there is a nation: there is no nation
decisions.reason: In an oath, "if there is" means "there is not": the speaker leaves unsaid the curse he would accept if it were so.

decisions.choice: made them swear: Ahab demanded an oath
decisions.reason: Ahab did not trust a simple denial. He made the rulers of each land swear that Elijah was not hiding there. The search shows that Ahab held Elijah responsible for the drought (verse 17).

decisions.choice: there is no nation (Literal)
decisions.reason: Literal gives the meaning of the oath form, since "if there is" would mislead in English.
The style guide keeps "जाति" (which also means caste) out of Balanced and Readable for a nation.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֖ה אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֑ר לֵ֛ךְ אֱמֹ֥ר לַאדֹנֶ֖יךָ הִנֵּ֥ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now you [are] saying, Go, say to your lord, Here [is] Elijah.

en.L: And now you [are] saying, 'Go, say to your lord, "Here [is] Elijah."'
en.B: And now you are telling me, 'Go and tell your master, "Elijah is here."'
en.R: And now you tell me, 'Go and tell your master, "Elijah is here!"'

es.L: Y ahora tú dices: “Ve, di a tu señor: ‘He aquí Elías’”.
es.B: Y ahora tú me dices: “Ve y dile a tu señor: ‘Elías está aquí’”.
es.R: Y ahora me dices: “Ve y dile a tu señor: ‘¡Elías está aquí!’”.

fr.L: Et maintenant tu dis : “Va, dis à ton seigneur : ‘Voici Élie.’”
fr.B: Et maintenant tu me dis : “Va dire à ton maître : ‘Élie est ici.’”
fr.R: Et maintenant, tu me dis : “Va dire à ton maître : ‘Élie est ici !’”

sw.L: Na sasa wewe [unasema], 'Nenda, umwambie bwana wako, "Eliya [yuko] hapa."'
sw.B: Na sasa unaniambia, 'Nenda umwambie bwana wako, "Eliya yuko hapa."'
sw.R: Na sasa unaniambia, 'Nenda umwambie bwana wako, "Eliya yuko hapa!"'

vi.L: Bây giờ ông lại nói: 'Hãy đi nói với chúa của ông: "Có Ê-li đây."'
vi.B: Thế mà bây giờ ông lại bảo tôi: 'Hãy đi báo với chủ ông: "Ê-li đang ở đây."'
vi.R: Thế mà bây giờ ông bảo tôi: 'Hãy đi báo với chủ ông: "Ê-li đang ở đây!"'

ko.L: 그런데 이제 당신은 '가서 당신 주인에게 "엘리야가 여기 있습니다" 하고 말하라' 하십니다.
ko.B: 그런데 이제 당신은 저에게 '가서 당신 주인에게 "엘리야가 여기 있습니다" 하고 알리라' 하십니다.
ko.R: 그런데 이제 당신은 저에게 '가서 당신 주인에게 "엘리야가 여기 있습니다!" 하고 전하라' 하십니다.

pt.L: E agora o senhor [está] dizendo: 'Vá, diga ao seu senhor: "Eis [aqui] Elias."'
pt.B: E agora o senhor me diz: 'Vá dizer ao seu amo: "Elias está aqui."'
pt.R: E agora o senhor me diz: 'Vá dizer ao seu amo: "Elias está aqui!"'

am.L: አሁንም እርስዎ፦ “ሂድ፤ ለጌታህ፦ ‘እነሆ፣ ኤልያስ [አለ]’ በል” ይላሉ።
am.B: አሁንም እርስዎ፦ “ሂድና ለጌታህ ‘ኤልያስ እዚህ አለ’ ብለህ ንገረው” ይሉኛል።
am.R: አሁን ደግሞ “ሂድና ለጌታህ ‘ኤልያስ እዚህ አለ!’ ብለህ ንገረው” ይሉኛል።

hi.L: और अब आप कह रहे हैं, 'जाकर अपने स्वामी से कहो, "देखिए, एलिय्याह [यहाँ है]।"'
hi.B: और अब आप मुझसे कह रहे हैं, 'जाकर अपने स्वामी से कहो, "एलिय्याह यहाँ है।"'
hi.R: और अब आप मुझसे कहते हैं, 'जाकर अपने मालिक से कहो, "एलिय्याह यहाँ है!"'

ru.L: А теперь ты говоришь: “Иди, скажи твоему господину: ‘Вот Илия.’”
ru.B: А теперь ты говоришь мне: “Иди и скажи своему господину: ‘Илия здесь.’”
ru.R: А теперь ты говоришь мне: “Иди и скажи своему господину: ‘Илия здесь!’”

uk.L: А тепер ти кажеш: “Іди, скажи своєму панові: ‘Ось Ілля’”.
uk.B: А тепер ти кажеш мені: “Іди і скажи своєму панові: ‘Ілля тут’”.
uk.R: А тепер ти кажеш мені: “Іди і скажи своєму панові: ‘Ілля тут!’”

decisions.choice: and now: the contrast with Ahab's long search
decisions.reason: Obadiah repeats Elijah's words to show how impossible the order seems after all the king's searching.

decisions.choice: quotations inside quotations
decisions.reason: Obadiah quotes Elijah, who quotes what Obadiah is to say, so the words take single and then double quotation marks.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks inside single ones
decisions.reason: Obadiah quotes Elijah quoting the message, so the innermost quotation goes back to double marks, as in the English.

source.text: וְהָיָ֞ה אֲנִ֣י׀אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵאִתָּ֗ךְ וְר֨וּחַ יְהוָ֤ה׀יִֽשָּׂאֲךָ֙ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־אֵדָ֔ע וּבָ֨אתִי לְהַגִּ֧יד לְאַחְאָ֛ב וְלֹ֥א יִֽמְצָאֲךָ֖ וַהֲרָגָ֑נִי וְעַבְדְּךָ֛ יָרֵ֥א אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה מִנְּעֻרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, I will go from you, and [the] Spirit of Yahweh will carry you to where not I know; and I will come to tell Ahab and not he will find you, and he will kill me; and your servant has feared Yahweh from my youth.

en.L: And it will be, [when] I go from you, that the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will carry you to [a place] I do not know. And [when] I come to tell Ahab and he does not find you, he will kill me. And your servant has feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from my youth.
en.B: As soon as I leave you, the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will carry you off to some place I do not know. Then when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find you, he will kill me. Yet I, your servant, have revered {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} since I was young.
en.R: As soon as I leave you, the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} may carry you away to some place I do not know about. Then when I tell Ahab you are here and he cannot find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have worshiped {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} since I was a boy.

es.L: Y sucederá [que], [cuando] yo me vaya de ti, el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} te llevará a [un lugar] que yo no sé; y [cuando] yo vaya a decírselo a Acab y él no te halle, me matará. Y tu siervo teme {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} desde su juventud.
es.B: En cuanto me aleje de ti, el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} te llevará a algún lugar que yo no conozco. Entonces, cuando yo vaya a decírselo a Acab y él no te encuentre, me matará. Y yo, tu siervo, he reverenciado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} desde mi juventud.
es.R: En cuanto me aleje de ti, puede ser que el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} te lleve a algún lugar que yo no conozco. Entonces, cuando le diga a Acab que estás aquí y él no te encuentre, me matará. Pero yo, tu siervo, he adorado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} desde que era niño.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, [quand] je m’en irai d’auprès de toi, que l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} te transportera [en un lieu] que je ne connais pas. Et [quand] je viendrai le dire à Achab et qu’il ne te trouvera pas, il me tuera. Et ton serviteur craint {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis sa jeunesse.
fr.B: Dès que je t’aurai quitté, l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} t’emportera je ne sais où. Quand je viendrai prévenir Achab et qu’il ne te trouvera pas, il me tuera. Et pourtant, moi, ton serviteur, je crains {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis ma jeunesse.
fr.R: Dès que je t’aurai quitté, l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} risque de t’emporter je ne sais où. Alors, quand je dirai à Achab que tu es ici et qu’il ne te trouvera pas, il me tuera. Pourtant, moi, ton serviteur, j’adore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis que je suis petit.

sw.L: Itakuwa, nitakapoondoka kwako, Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuchukua mpaka [mahali] nisipopajua. Nami nitakapokuja kumwambia Ahabu, naye asikuone, ataniua. Na mtumishi wako amemcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tangu ujana wangu.
sw.B: Mara nitakapoondoka kwako, Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupeleka mahali nisipopajua. Kisha nitakapokwenda kumwambia Ahabu, naye asikuone, ataniua. Lakini mimi, mtumishi wako, nimemcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tangu ujana wangu.
sw.R: Mara nitakapoondoka kwako, huenda Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akakuchukua mpaka mahali nisipopajua. Kisha nitakapomwambia Ahabu kwamba uko hapa, naye asikuone, ataniua. Lakini mimi, mtumishi wako, nimemwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tangu nilipokuwa mvulana.

vi.L: Xảy ra, [khi] tôi rời khỏi ông, Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đem ông đến [nơi] tôi không biết; rồi [khi] tôi đến báo cho A-háp mà vua không tìm thấy ông, vua sẽ giết tôi. Thế mà đầy tớ ông đã kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ thuở nhỏ.
vi.B: Ngay khi tôi rời khỏi ông, Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đem ông đi đến một nơi nào tôi không biết. Rồi khi tôi đến báo cho A-háp mà vua không tìm thấy ông, vua sẽ giết tôi. Thế mà đầy tớ ông đã kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ thuở nhỏ.
vi.R: Ngay khi tôi rời khỏi ông, có thể Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đem ông đi đến một nơi nào đó tôi không biết. Rồi khi tôi báo cho A-háp rằng ông đang ở đây mà vua không tìm thấy ông, vua sẽ giết tôi. Nhưng đầy tớ của ông đã thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ khi còn bé.

ko.L: 그리고 제가 당신을 떠나가면, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 당신을 제가 알지 못하는 곳으로 데려가실 것입니다. 그러면 제가 아합에게 가서 알렸는데 그가 당신을 찾지 못하면, 그는 저를 죽일 것입니다. 당신의 종은 어려서부터 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외해 왔습니다.
ko.B: 제가 당신을 떠나자마자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 당신을 제가 모르는 곳으로 데려가실 것입니다. 그러면 제가 아합에게 가서 알렸는데 그가 당신을 찾지 못하면 저를 죽일 것입니다. 그러나 당신의 종은 어려서부터 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외해 왔습니다.
ko.R: 제가 당신을 떠나자마자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 당신을 제가 모르는 곳으로 데려가실지도 모릅니다. 그러면 제가 아합에게 당신이 여기 있다고 말했는데 그가 당신을 찾지 못하면, 그는 저를 죽일 것입니다. 저는 어릴 때부터 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨 왔습니다.

pt.L: E será [que], [quando] eu me for do senhor, o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} o levará para [um lugar] que eu não sei. E [quando] eu chegar para contar a Acabe, e ele não o encontrar, ele me matará. E o seu servo teme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} desde a minha juventude.
pt.B: Assim que eu sair de perto do senhor, o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} vai levá-lo para algum lugar que eu não conheço. Então, quando eu chegar e contar a Acabe, e ele não o encontrar, ele vai me matar. E eu, o seu servo, temo {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} desde a minha juventude.
pt.R: Assim que eu deixar o senhor, o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} pode levá-lo para algum lugar que eu não conheço. Então, quando eu contar a Acabe que o senhor está aqui e ele não o encontrar, ele vai me matar. Mas eu, o seu servo, adoro {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} desde menino.

am.L: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እኔ ከእርስዎ ዘንድ በሄድኩ ጊዜ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መንፈስ ወደማላውቀው [ስፍራ] ይወስድዎታል፤ እኔም ለአክዓብ ልነግረው በመጣሁ ጊዜ ባያገኝዎ ይገድለኛል፤ ባሪያዎ ግን ከብላቴናነቴ ጀምሮ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ሲፈራ ኖሯል።
am.B: ከእርስዎ ተለይቼ እንደ ሄድኩ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መንፈስ ወደማላውቀው ስፍራ ይወስድዎታል። ከዚያም ሄጄ ለአክዓብ በነገርኩት ጊዜ እርስዎን ባያገኝዎ ይገድለኛል። እኔ አገልጋይዎ ግን ከልጅነቴ ጀምሮ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ስፈራ ኖሬአለሁ።
am.R: ከእርስዎ እንደ ተለየሁ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መንፈስ ወደማላውቀው ስፍራ ሊወስድዎ ይችላል። ከዚያም እርስዎ እዚህ እንዳሉ ለአክዓብ ስነግረው እርሱም ባያገኝዎ ይገድለኛል። እኔ አገልጋይዎ ግን ከልጅነቴ ጀምሮ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ሳመልክ ኖሬአለሁ።

hi.L: और ऐसा होगा कि [जब] मैं आपके पास से जाऊँगा, तो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आत्मा आपको न जाने कहाँ उठा ले जाएगा। और [जब] मैं अहाब को बताने जाऊँगा और वह आपको न पाएगा, तो वह मुझे मार डालेगा। और आपका दास बचपन से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय मानता आया है।
hi.B: जैसे ही मैं आपके पास से जाऊँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आत्मा आपको किसी ऐसी जगह उठा ले जाएगा जिसे मैं नहीं जानता। फिर जब मैं जाकर अहाब को बताऊँगा और वह आपको न पाएगा, तो वह मुझे मार डालेगा। फिर भी आपका दास बचपन से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय मानता आया है।
hi.R: जैसे ही मैं आपके पास से जाऊँगा, हो सकता है {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आत्मा आपको कहीं और उठा ले जाए, जहाँ का मुझे पता भी न हो। फिर जब मैं अहाब को बताऊँगा कि आप यहाँ हैं और वह आपको नहीं पाएगा, तो वह मुझे मार डालेगा। पर मैं, आपका दास, लड़कपन से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की उपासना करता आया हूँ।

ru.L: И будет: [когда] я уйду от тебя, Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} унесёт тебя, не знаю куда. И [когда] я приду сказать Ахаву, а он не найдёт тебя, он убьёт меня. А твой раб боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} с юности своей.
ru.B: Как только я уйду от тебя, Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} унесёт тебя туда, где я не знаю. И когда я приду и скажу Ахаву, а он тебя не найдёт, он убьёт меня. А ведь я, твой раб, почитаю {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} с юности.
ru.R: Как только я уйду от тебя, Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} может унести тебя куда-нибудь, и я не буду знать куда. Потом я скажу Ахаву, что ты здесь, а он не найдёт тебя и убьёт меня. А ведь я, твой раб, поклоняюсь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} с детства.

uk.L: І буде, [коли] я піду від тебе, то Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} занесе тебе туди, де я не знаю. І [коли] я прийду сказати Ахавові, а він не знайде тебе, то вбʼє мене. А твій раб боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} від своєї юності.
uk.B: Щойно я відійду від тебе, Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} занесе тебе кудись, де я не знаю. Тоді, коли я прийду і скажу Ахавові, а він не зможе тебе знайти, він убʼє мене. А я, твій слуга, шаную {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} змолоду.
uk.R: Щойно я відійду від тебе, Дух {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} може занести тебе кудись, де я не знатиму. Тоді, коли я скажу Ахавові, що ти тут, а він не зможе тебе знайти, він убʼє мене. Але я, твій слуга, шаную {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} з дитинства.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of Yahweh: God's Spirit, who could move the prophet suddenly
decisions.reason: The word can mean "wind" or "spirit". Here it is Yahweh's Spirit, thought able to carry a prophet from place to place (2 Kings 2:16; Ezekiel 3:14). Obadiah fears Elijah will vanish as suddenly as he has appeared.

decisions.choice: it will be ... I go: a chain of things Obadiah expects to happen
decisions.reason: The verbs describe what Obadiah fears will follow, one after another: he leaves, Elijah is carried away, he reports, Ahab finds no one, and Ahab kills him.

decisions.choice: your servant has feared Yahweh from my youth
decisions.reason: Obadiah reminds Elijah that he is a faithful worshiper of Yahweh, as the narrator said (verse 3), and should not be thrown away. The pronoun shifts from "your servant" to "my", as often in polite speech.

decisions.choice: may carry you away (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable softens "will" to "may" because Obadiah is describing what he fears, not what he knows.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của CHÚA"
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's wording for the Spirit of the LORD, at every level.

decisions.choice: "प्रभु का आत्मा" (masculine)
decisions.reason: The Spirit of the LORD as the history terms note sets, with masculine agreement ("उठा ले जाएगा") as in the New Testament.

decisions.choice: "Дух ГОСПОДА"
decisions.reason: As the history terms note sets.
