source.text: הֲלֹֽא־הֻגַּ֤ד לַֽאדֹנִי֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֔יתִי בַּהֲרֹ֣ג אִיזֶ֔בֶל אֵ֖ת נְבִיאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וָאַחְבִּא֩ מִנְּבִיאֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה מֵ֣אָה אִ֗ישׁ חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ בַּמְּעָרָ֔ה וָאֲכַלְכְּלֵ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם וָמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Has not it been told to my lord what I did when killed Jezebel the prophets of Yahweh, and I hid of [the] prophets of Yahweh a hundred man, fifty fifty man in a cave, and supplied them [with] bread and water?

en.L: Has it not been told to my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I hid a hundred men of the prophets of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, fifty [and] fifty men in a cave, and supplied them [with] bread and water?
en.B: Has my lord not been told what I did when Jezebel was killing the prophets of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? I hid a hundred of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s prophets, fifty in each of two caves, and kept them supplied with food and water.
en.R: Sir, has no one told you what I did when Jezebel was killing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s prophets? I hid a hundred of them in two caves, fifty in each cave. And I gave them food and water.

es.L: ¿No le han contado a mi señor lo que hice cuando Jezabel mataba a los profetas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que escondí a cien hombres de los profetas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, de cincuenta en cincuenta por cueva, y los sustenté con pan y agua?
es.B: ¿No le han contado a mi señor lo que hice cuando Jezabel estaba matando a los profetas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? Escondí a cien profetas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, cincuenta en cada una de dos cuevas, y los proveí de comida y agua.
es.R: Señor, ¿nadie te ha contado lo que hice cuando Jezabel estaba matando a los profetas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? Escondí a cien de ellos en dos cuevas, cincuenta en cada cueva. Y les di comida y agua.

fr.L: N’a-t-on pas raconté à mon seigneur ce que j’ai fait quand Jézabel tuait les prophètes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et que j’ai caché cent hommes d’entre les prophètes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, cinquante [et] cinquante hommes par grotte, et que je les ai ravitaillés en pain et en eau ?
fr.B: Ne t’a-t-on pas raconté, mon seigneur, ce que j’ai fait quand Jézabel tuait les prophètes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? J’ai caché cent des prophètes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, cinquante dans chacune de deux grottes, et je les ai ravitaillés en pain et en eau.
fr.R: Mon maître, personne ne t’a raconté ce que j’ai fait quand Jézabel faisait tuer les prophètes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? J’en ai caché cent dans deux grottes, cinquante dans chacune. Et je leur ai donné à manger et à boire.

sw.L: Je, bwana wangu hakuambiwa niliyoyafanya Yezebeli alipowaua manabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, jinsi nilivyowaficha watu mia moja wa manabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hamsini hamsini katika pango, nikawapa mkate na maji?
sw.B: Je, bwana wangu hakuambiwa niliyoyafanya Yezebeli alipokuwa akiwaua manabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Niliwaficha manabii mia moja wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hamsini katika kila pango kati ya mapango mawili, nikawa nikiwapa chakula na maji.
sw.R: Bwana, je, hakuna mtu aliyekuambia niliyoyafanya Yezebeli alipokuwa akiwaua manabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Niliwaficha mia moja kati yao katika mapango mawili, hamsini katika kila pango. Nikawapa chakula na maji.

vi.L: Chẳng lẽ người ta chưa thuật cho chúa tôi những gì tôi đã làm khi Giê-sa-bên giết các nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi đã giấu một trăm người trong các nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mỗi hang năm mươi người, và cung cấp bánh và nước cho họ sao?
vi.B: Chúa tôi chưa nghe kể những gì tôi đã làm khi Giê-sa-bên giết các nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sao? Tôi đã giấu một trăm nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong hai cái hang, mỗi hang năm mươi người, và tiếp tế bánh và nước cho họ.
vi.R: Thưa thầy, chẳng lẽ chưa ai kể cho thầy nghe tôi đã làm gì khi Giê-sa-bên đang giết các nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sao? Tôi đã giấu một trăm nhà tiên tri trong hai cái hang, mỗi hang năm mươi người. Tôi đã tiếp tế thức ăn và nước uống cho họ.

ko.L: 이세벨이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자들을 죽일 때에 제가 한 일, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자 가운데 백 명을 한 굴에 오십 명씩 숨기고 그들에게 빵과 물을 대 준 일이 내 주께 알려지지 않았습니까?
ko.B: 이세벨이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자들을 죽일 때에 제가 한 일을 내 주께서는 듣지 못하셨습니까? 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자 백 명을 두 굴에 오십 명씩 숨기고 먹을 것과 마실 물을 대 주었습니다.
ko.R: 어른께서는 이세벨이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자들을 죽일 때에 제가 한 일을 아무에게서도 듣지 못하셨습니까? 저는 예언자 백 명을 두 굴에 오십 명씩 숨겨 주었습니다. 그리고 그들에게 먹을 것과 물을 주었습니다.

pt.L: Não foi contado ao meu senhor o que fiz quando Jezabel matou os profetas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e [como] escondi cem homens dos profetas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, cinquenta [e] cinquenta homens numa caverna, e os sustentei com pão e água?
pt.B: Não contaram ao meu senhor o que eu fiz quando Jezabel estava matando os profetas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Escondi cem dos profetas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, cinquenta em cada uma de duas cavernas, e os sustentei com comida e água.
pt.R: Senhor, ninguém lhe contou o que eu fiz quando Jezabel estava matando os profetas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Escondi cem deles em duas cavernas, cinquenta em cada caverna. E dei comida e água a eles.

am.L: ኤልዛቤል {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ነቢያት በገደለች ጊዜ ያደረግኩት፣ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ነቢያት መቶ ሰዎችን በዋሻ ሃምሳ ሃምሳ ሰው አድርጌ እንደ ሸሸግኳቸው፣ በእንጀራና በውኃም እንደ ቀለብኳቸው ለጌታዬ አልተነገረውምን?
am.B: ኤልዛቤል {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ነቢያት በምትገድልበት ጊዜ ያደረግኩት ለጌታዬ አልተነገረውምን? {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ነቢያት መቶውን በሁለት ዋሻዎች፣ በእያንዳንዱ ሃምሳ ሃምሳ አድርጌ ሸሸግኳቸው፤ ምግብና ውኃም አቀረብኩላቸው።
am.R: ጌታዬ ሆይ፣ ኤልዛቤል {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ነቢያት በምትገድልበት ጊዜ ያደረግኩትን ማንም አልነገረዎትም? ከእነርሱ መቶውን በሁለት ዋሻዎች፣ በእያንዳንዱ ዋሻ ሃምሳ ሃምሳ አድርጌ ደበቅኳቸው። ምግብና ውኃም ሰጠኋቸው።

hi.L: क्या मेरे स्वामी को यह नहीं बताया गया कि जब ईज़ेबेल {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को मार रही थी तब मैंने क्या किया, कि मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भविष्यद्वक्ताओं में से सौ पुरुषों को पचास-पचास करके एक-एक गुफा में छिपा रखा, और उन्हें रोटी और पानी पहुँचाता रहा?
hi.B: क्या मेरे स्वामी को किसी ने नहीं बताया कि जब ईज़ेबेल {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को मरवा रही थी, तब मैंने क्या किया? मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सौ भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को दो गुफाओं में पचास-पचास करके छिपा रखा, और उन्हें भोजन और पानी पहुँचाता रहा।
hi.R: श्रीमान, क्या किसी ने आपको नहीं बताया कि जब ईज़ेबेल {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नबियों को मरवा रही थी तब मैंने क्या किया? मैंने उनमें से सौ को दो गुफाओं में, हर गुफा में पचास करके, छिपा दिया। और मैं उन्हें खाना और पानी देता रहा।

ru.L: Разве не сказано моему господину, что я сделал, когда Иезавель убивала пророков {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и я спрятал из пророков {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} сто человек, по пятьдесят человек в пещере, и снабжал их хлебом и водой?
ru.B: Разве моему господину не рассказали, что я сделал, когда Иезавель убивала пророков {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}? Я спрятал сто пророков {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, по пятьдесят в двух пещерах, и снабжал их хлебом и водой.
ru.R: Господин мой, неужели тебе никто не рассказал, что я сделал, когда Иезавель убивала пророков {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}? Я спрятал сто из них в двух пещерах, по пятьдесят в каждой. И я давал им еду и воду.

uk.L: Хіба не сказали моєму панові, що я зробив, коли Єзавель убивала пророків {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, — як я сховав з пророків {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} сто чоловік, по пʼятдесят чоловік у печері, і годував їх хлібом і водою?
uk.B: Хіба моєму панові не розповіли, що я зробив, коли Єзавель убивала пророків {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}? Я сховав сотню пророків {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, по пʼятдесят у двох печерах, і постачав їм хліб і воду.
uk.R: Пане, хіба ніхто не розповів тобі, що я зробив, коли Єзавель убивала пророків {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}? Я сховав сотню з них у двох печерах, по пʼятдесят у кожній. І я давав їм їжу і воду.

decisions.choice: has it not been told: surely you have heard
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer yes. Obadiah appeals to a deed that the prophets themselves would have reported.

decisions.choice: fifty, fifty men: fifty in each cave
decisions.reason: Repeating a number gives it a sense of "each". The hundred were split into two groups of fifty. See verse 4.

decisions.choice: my lord (Literal, Balanced); sir (Readable)
decisions.reason: Obadiah addresses Elijah politely in the third person. Readable turns it into direct address.

decisions.choice: "मेरे स्वामी" in the third person (L, B); "श्रीमान ... आपको" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep Obadiah's courtly third person, as the English; Readable speaks to Elijah directly, as the English Readable does ("Sir").

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֔ר לֵ֛ךְ אֱמֹ֥ר לַֽאדֹנֶ֖יךָ הִנֵּ֣ה אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַהֲרָגָֽנִי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And now you [are] saying, Go, say to your lord, Here [is] Elijah; and he will kill me.

en.L: And now you [are] saying, 'Go, say to your lord, "Here [is] Elijah,"' and he will kill me!"
en.B: And now you are telling me, 'Go and tell your master, "Elijah is here."' He will kill me!"
en.R: And now you tell me to go and tell my master that you are here! He will kill me!"

es.L: Y ahora tú dices: “Ve, di a tu señor: ‘He aquí Elías’”; ¡y me matará!».
es.B: Y ahora tú me dices: “Ve y dile a tu señor: ‘Elías está aquí’”. ¡Me matará!».
es.R: ¡Y ahora me dices que vaya y le diga a mi señor que estás aquí! ¡Me matará!».

fr.L: Et maintenant tu dis : “Va, dis à ton seigneur : ‘Voici Élie’”, et il me tuera ! »
fr.B: Et maintenant tu me dis : “Va dire à ton maître : ‘Élie est ici.’” Il me tuera ! »
fr.R: Et maintenant, tu me dis d’aller dire à mon maître que tu es ici ! Il va me tuer ! »

sw.L: Na sasa wewe [unasema], 'Nenda, umwambie bwana wako, "Eliya [yuko] hapa,"' naye ataniua!"
sw.B: Na sasa unaniambia, 'Nenda umwambie bwana wako, "Eliya yuko hapa."' Ataniua!"
sw.R: Na sasa unaniambia niende nimwambie bwana wangu kwamba uko hapa! Ataniua!"

vi.L: Thế mà bây giờ ông lại nói: 'Hãy đi nói với chúa của ông: "Có Ê-li đây,"' và vua sẽ giết tôi!"
vi.B: Thế mà bây giờ ông lại bảo tôi: 'Hãy đi báo với chủ ông: "Ê-li đang ở đây."' Vua sẽ giết tôi mất!"
vi.R: Thế mà bây giờ ông bảo tôi đi báo với chủ tôi rằng ông đang ở đây! Vua sẽ giết tôi mất!"

ko.L: 그런데 이제 당신은 '가서 당신 주인에게 "엘리야가 여기 있습니다" 하고 말하라' 하십니다. 그러면 그는 저를 죽일 것입니다!"
ko.B: 그런데 이제 당신은 저에게 '가서 당신 주인에게 "엘리야가 여기 있습니다" 하고 알리라' 하십니다. 그는 저를 죽일 것입니다!"
ko.R: 그런데 이제 당신은 저더러 주인에게 가서 당신이 여기 있다고 말하라고 하십니다! 그는 저를 죽일 것입니다!"

pt.L: E agora o senhor [está] dizendo: 'Vá, diga ao seu senhor: "Eis [aqui] Elias"', e ele me matará!"
pt.B: E agora o senhor me diz: 'Vá dizer ao seu amo: "Elias está aqui."' Ele vai me matar!"
pt.R: E agora o senhor me manda dizer ao meu amo que o senhor está aqui! Ele vai me matar!"

am.L: አሁንም እርስዎ፦ “ሂድ፤ ለጌታህ፦ ‘እነሆ፣ ኤልያስ [አለ]’ በል” ይላሉ፤ እርሱም ይገድለኛል!»
am.B: አሁንም እርስዎ፦ “ሂድና ለጌታህ ‘ኤልያስ እዚህ አለ’ ብለህ ንገረው” ይሉኛል። እርሱ ይገድለኛል!»
am.R: አሁን ደግሞ ሄጄ እርስዎ እዚህ እንዳሉ ለጌታዬ እንድነግረው ይሉኛል! እርሱ ይገድለኛል!»

hi.L: और अब आप कह रहे हैं, 'जाकर अपने स्वामी से कहो, "देखिए, एलिय्याह [यहाँ है],"' और वह मुझे मार डालेगा!"
hi.B: और अब आप मुझसे कह रहे हैं, 'जाकर अपने स्वामी से कहो, "एलिय्याह यहाँ है।"' वह मुझे मार डालेगा!"
hi.R: और अब आप कहते हैं कि मैं जाकर अपने मालिक को बताऊँ कि आप यहाँ हैं! वह मुझे मार डालेगा!"

ru.L: А теперь ты говоришь: “Иди, скажи твоему господину: ‘Вот Илия’”, — и он убьёт меня!»
ru.B: А теперь ты говоришь мне: “Иди и скажи своему господину: ‘Илия здесь.’” Он убьёт меня!»
ru.R: А теперь ты велишь мне пойти и сказать моему господину, что ты здесь! Он убьёт меня!»

uk.L: А тепер ти кажеш: “Іди, скажи своєму панові: ‘Ось Ілля’”, — і він убʼє мене!»
uk.B: А тепер ти кажеш мені: “Іди і скажи своєму панові: ‘Ілля тут’”. Він убʼє мене!»
uk.R: А тепер ти кажеш мені піти і сказати моєму панові, що ти тут! Він убʼє мене!»

decisions.choice: and he will kill me: the end Obadiah sees ahead
decisions.reason: Obadiah repeats verse 11 word for word and adds the conclusion he has argued in verse 12. The repetition shows his fear.

decisions.choice: to go and tell my master that you are here (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable turns the quotation within a quotation into reported speech.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵֽלִיָּ֔הוּ חַ֚י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָמַ֖דְתִּי לְפָנָ֑יו כִּ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם אֵרָאֶ֥ה אֵלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Elijah, [As] lives Yahweh of hosts before whom I stand, surely today I will show myself to him.

en.L: And Elijah said, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts lives, before whom I stand, surely today I will show myself to him."
en.B: Elijah said, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies lives, whom I serve, I will present myself to Ahab today."
en.R: Elijah said, "I serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. As surely as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives, I will meet Ahab face to face today."

es.L: Y dijo Elías: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, delante de quien estoy, que hoy mismo me mostraré a él».
es.B: Elías dijo: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, a quien sirvo, hoy me presentaré ante Acab».
es.R: Elías dijo: «Yo sirvo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Tan cierto como que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive, hoy me encontraré cara a cara con Acab».

fr.L: Et Élie dit : « [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est vivant, lui devant qui je me tiens, aujourd’hui même je me montrerai à lui. »
fr.B: Élie répondit : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est vivant, lui que je sers, je me présenterai aujourd’hui devant Achab. »
fr.R: Élie a dit : « Je sers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Aussi vrai qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est vivant, aujourd’hui je vais me trouver face à face avec Achab. »

sw.L: Eliya akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi aishivyo, ambaye nimesimama mbele zake, hakika leo nitajionyesha kwake."
sw.B: Eliya akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi aishivyo, ambaye ninamtumikia, leo nitajitokeza mbele ya Ahabu."
sw.R: Eliya akasema, "Mimi ninamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aishivyo, leo nitakutana na Ahabu uso kwa uso."

vi.L: Ê-li nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân hằng sống, là Đấng tôi đứng trước mặt, hôm nay tôi chắc chắn sẽ ra mắt vua."
vi.B: Ê-li nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân hằng sống, là Đấng tôi phục vụ, hôm nay tôi sẽ ra mắt A-háp."
vi.R: Ê-li nói: "Tôi phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân. Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hằng sống, hôm nay tôi sẽ gặp mặt A-háp."

ko.L: 그러자 엘리야가 말했다. "내가 그 앞에 서 있는 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하오. 내가 오늘 반드시 그에게 나를 보이겠소."
ko.B: 엘리야가 말했다. "내가 섬기는 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 오늘 내가 반드시 아합 앞에 나타나겠소."
ko.R: 엘리야가 말했다. "나는 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 사람이오. 그분께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 오늘 내가 꼭 아합을 만나겠소."

pt.L: E Elias disse: "[Tão certo como] vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, diante de quem estou, certamente hoje me mostrarei a ele."
pt.B: Elias disse: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, a quem eu sirvo, hoje mesmo vou me apresentar a Acabe."
pt.R: Elias disse: "Eu sirvo {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. Tão certo como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vive, hoje vou me encontrar face a face com Acabe."

am.L: ኤልያስም፦ «በፊቱ የቆምኩት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት ሕያው ነውና፣ ዛሬ በእርግጥ ራሴን ለእርሱ አሳያለሁ» አለ።
am.B: ኤልያስም፦ «የማገለግለው የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕያው ነውና፣ ዛሬ በአክዓብ ፊት እቀርባለሁ» አለ።
am.R: ኤልያስም እንዲህ አለ፦ «እኔ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አገለግላለሁ። ሕያው በሆነው በእርሱ እምላለሁ፤ ዛሬ ከአክዓብ ጋር ፊት ለፊት እገናኛለሁ።»

hi.L: और एलिय्याह ने कहा, "सेनाओं के जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ, जिनके सामने मैं खड़ा रहता हूँ, आज मैं निश्चय अपने आप को उसे दिखाऊँगा।"
hi.B: एलिय्याह ने कहा, "सेनाओं के जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ, जिनकी सेवा मैं करता हूँ, आज मैं अहाब के सामने हाज़िर हो जाऊँगा।"
hi.R: एलिय्याह ने कहा, "मैं सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सेवा करता हूँ। उनके जीवन की शपथ, आज मैं अहाब से आमने-सामने मिलूँगा।"

ru.L: И сказал Илия: «[Как] жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, перед которым я стою, — сегодня я непременно покажусь ему.»
ru.B: Илия сказал: «Как верно то, что жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, которому я служу, сегодня я явлюсь к Ахаву.»
ru.R: Илия сказал: «Я служу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} Воинств. Как верно то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} жив, сегодня я встречусь с Ахавом лицом к лицу.»

uk.L: І сказав Ілля: «[Як] живий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, перед яким я стою, справді сьогодні я покажуся йому».
uk.B: Ілля сказав: «Як певно, що живий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, якому я служу, я сьогодні стану перед Ахавом».
uk.R: Ілля сказав: «Я служу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} Вседержителю. Як певно, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} живий, я сьогодні зустрінуся з Ахавом віч-на-віч».

decisions.choice: Yahweh of hosts: Yahweh, ruler of the armies of heaven and earth
decisions.reason: "Hosts" means armies. The title presents Yahweh as commander of all the powers in heaven and on earth (1 Samuel 17:45; Psalm 24:10). Elijah uses it before he faces the king and his prophets.

decisions.choice: before whom I stand: whom I serve
decisions.reason: To stand before a king is to be in his service, ready to act on his word (10:8; 12:8). Elijah used the same words when he announced the drought (17:1).

decisions.choice: surely: the oath's promise
decisions.reason: After an oath, this word introduces what the speaker swears he will do.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts (Literal); the LORD of Armies (Balanced, Readable); whom I serve
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this title in these books. Balanced and Readable say what "stand before" means.

decisions.choice: "el SEÑOR de los ejércitos" (L); "el SEÑOR de los Ejércitos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note sets for Spanish.

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: one wording for the title in French at every level.

decisions.choice: BWANA wa majeshi, at every level
decisions.reason: "The LORD of hosts" is "BWANA wa majeshi" at every level, as the Samuel and Psalms notes set; Swahili "majeshi" already says "armies", so Balanced and Readable need no change where the English says "of Armies".

decisions.choice: "CHÚA Vạn Quân" at every level
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's wording for "the LORD of hosts / of Armies", the span on CHÚA only.

decisions.choice: "만군의 주" (L, B), "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 주" (R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's wording for "the LORD of hosts".

decisions.choice: o SENHOR dos Exércitos (every level)
decisions.reason: The title (m1) keeps the Old Testament terms and 1 Samuel 1:3 in Portuguese at every level; "Exércitos" already says what the English Balanced and Readable say with "Armies", so Literal needs no other word.

decisions.choice: YHWH Tsevaot: "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት" (Literal); "የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The title as the terms list and 1 Kings 1 set it: Literal keeps the Hebrew word, which means "armies"; the other levels say it.

decisions.choice: "सेनाओं के प्रभु" at every level
decisions.reason: The LORD of hosts as the history terms note and Romans 9:29, also where the English Balanced and Readable say "of Armies", as in 2 Samuel.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф" (L, B); "ГОСПОДЬ Воинств" (R)
decisions.reason: As the history terms note sets, after Romans 9:29.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДЬ Саваот" (L), "ГОСПОДЬ Небесних Військ" (B), "ГОСПОДЬ Вседержитель" (R), as the terms note sets them
decisions.reason: The terms note fixes one wording per level for this title through the Old Testament.

source.text: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ עֹבַדְיָ֛הוּ לִקְרַ֥את אַחְאָ֖ב וַיַּגֶּד־ל֑וֹ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אַחְאָ֖ב לִקְרַ֥את אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Obadiah to meet Ahab and told him; and went Ahab to meet Elijah.

en.L: And Obadiah went to meet Ahab and told him, and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
en.B: So Obadiah went off to meet Ahab and told him, and Ahab set out to meet Elijah.
en.R: So Obadiah went and found Ahab and told him the news. Then Ahab went out to meet Elijah.

es.L: Y Abdías fue al encuentro de Acab y se lo dijo; y Acab fue al encuentro de Elías.
es.B: Así que Abdías fue a encontrarse con Acab y se lo dijo, y Acab salió al encuentro de Elías.
es.R: Así que Abdías fue, encontró a Acab y le dio la noticia. Entonces Acab salió al encuentro de Elías.

fr.L: Et Abdias alla à la rencontre d’Achab et le lui rapporta ; et Achab alla à la rencontre d’Élie.
fr.B: Abdias partit donc à la rencontre d’Achab et le mit au courant, et Achab se mit en route pour rencontrer Élie.
fr.R: Abdias est donc allé trouver Achab et il lui a annoncé la nouvelle. Alors Achab est sorti à la rencontre d’Élie.

sw.L: Obadia akaenda kumlaki Ahabu, akamwambia; naye Ahabu akaenda kumlaki Eliya.
sw.B: Basi Obadia akaenda kukutana na Ahabu, akamwambia, naye Ahabu akaondoka kwenda kukutana na Eliya.
sw.R: Basi Obadia akaenda akamkuta Ahabu, akamweleza habari hiyo. Kisha Ahabu akatoka kwenda kukutana na Eliya.

vi.L: Áp-đia đi gặp A-háp và báo cho vua; rồi A-háp đi gặp Ê-li.
vi.B: Vậy Áp-đia đi gặp A-háp và báo tin cho vua, và A-háp lên đường đi gặp Ê-li.
vi.R: Vậy Áp-đia đi tìm A-háp và báo tin cho vua. Rồi A-háp đi ra gặp Ê-li.

ko.L: 그리고 오바댜가 아합을 만나러 가서 그에게 알렸다. 그러자 아합이 엘리야를 만나러 갔다.
ko.B: 그래서 오바댜는 아합을 만나러 가서 그에게 알렸다. 그러자 아합이 엘리야를 만나러 나섰다.
ko.R: 그래서 오바댜는 아합을 찾아가서 그 소식을 전했다. 그러자 아합이 엘리야를 만나러 나왔다.

pt.L: E Obadias foi ao encontro de Acabe e lhe contou; e Acabe foi ao encontro de Elias.
pt.B: Então Obadias foi ao encontro de Acabe e lhe contou tudo, e Acabe saiu ao encontro de Elias.
pt.R: Então Obadias foi, encontrou Acabe e lhe deu a notícia. Depois Acabe foi se encontrar com Elias.

am.L: አብድዩም አክዓብን ሊገናኘው ሄዶ ነገረው፤ አክዓብም ኤልያስን ሊገናኘው ሄደ።
am.B: ስለዚህ አብድዩ አክዓብን ሊገናኘው ሄዶ ነገረው፤ አክዓብም ኤልያስን ሊገናኘው ወጣ።
am.R: ስለዚህ አብድዩ ሄዶ አክዓብን አገኘውና ወሬውን ነገረው። ከዚያም አክዓብ ኤልያስን ሊገናኘው ወጣ።

hi.L: और ओबद्याह अहाब से मिलने गया और उसे बताया; और अहाब एलिय्याह से मिलने गया।
hi.B: तब ओबद्याह अहाब से मिलने गया और उसे बता दिया, और अहाब एलिय्याह से मिलने निकल पड़ा।
hi.R: तब ओबद्याह गया, अहाब को ढूँढ़ा और उसे यह ख़बर दी। फिर अहाब एलिय्याह से मिलने निकला।

ru.L: И пошёл Авдий навстречу Ахаву и сообщил ему. И пошёл Ахав навстречу Илии.
ru.B: Авдий пошёл навстречу Ахаву и сообщил ему, и Ахав отправился навстречу Илии.
ru.R: Авдий пошёл, нашёл Ахава и всё ему рассказал. Тогда Ахав вышел навстречу Илии.

uk.L: І пішов Овдій назустріч Ахавові, і сказав йому; і пішов Ахав назустріч Іллі.
uk.B: Тож Овдій пішов назустріч Ахавові і сказав йому, і Ахав вирушив назустріч Іллі.
uk.R: Тож Овдій пішов, знайшов Ахава і переказав йому новину. Тоді Ахав вийшов назустріч Іллі.

decisions.choice: Obadiah went ... Ahab went: the meeting is set up
decisions.reason: Two matching clauses show Obadiah obeying and the king coming. Elijah, who had hidden from Ahab (17:3), now waits for the king to come to him.

source.text: וַיְהִ֛י כִּרְא֥וֹת אַחְאָ֖ב אֶת־אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ אֵלָ֔יו הַאַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה עֹכֵ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was as saw Ahab Elijah, and said Ahab to him, [Is] this you, troubler of Israel?

en.L: And it was, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said to him, "[Is] it you, troubler of Israel?"
en.B: When Ahab saw Elijah, he said to him, "Is it you, you troubler of Israel?"
en.R: As soon as Ahab saw Elijah, he said to him, "So it is you, the man who brings trouble on Israel!"

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Acab vio a Elías, Acab le dijo: «¿[Eres] tú, perturbador de Israel?».
es.B: Cuando Acab vio a Elías, le dijo: «¿Eres tú, el que perturba a Israel?».
es.R: En cuanto Acab vio a Elías, le dijo: «¡Así que eres tú, el hombre que le trae problemas a Israel!».

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Achab vit Élie, qu’Achab lui dit : « [Est-ce] toi, fléau d’Israël ? »
fr.B: Quand Achab vit Élie, il lui dit : « Est-ce toi, toi qui jettes le trouble en Israël ? »
fr.R: Dès qu’Achab a vu Élie, il lui a dit : « Te voilà donc, toi qui attires le malheur sur Israël ! »

sw.L: Ikawa, Ahabu alipomwona Eliya, Ahabu akamwambia, "Je, ni wewe, mtaabishaji wa Israeli?"
sw.B: Ahabu alipomwona Eliya, alimwambia, "Je, ni wewe, wewe mtaabishaji wa Israeli?"
sw.R: Mara Ahabu alipomwona Eliya, alimwambia, "Kumbe ni wewe, mtu anayeleta taabu juu ya Israeli!"

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi A-háp thấy Ê-li, A-háp nói với ông: "[Có phải] ông đó không, kẻ làm rối loạn Y-sơ-ra-ên?"
vi.B: Vừa thấy Ê-li, A-háp nói: "Có phải ông đó không, kẻ làm khốn đốn Y-sơ-ra-ên?"
vi.R: Vừa thấy Ê-li, A-háp nói với ông: "Thì ra là ông, kẻ đem tai họa đến cho Y-sơ-ra-ên!"

ko.L: 그리고 아합이 엘리야를 보았을 때, 아합이 그에게 말했다. "너냐, 이스라엘을 괴롭히는 자야?"
ko.B: 아합은 엘리야를 보자 그에게 말했다. "이스라엘을 괴롭히는 자, 바로 네가 아니냐?"
ko.R: 아합은 엘리야를 보자마자 말했다. "너로구나, 이스라엘에 재앙을 가져온 자가!"

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando Acabe viu Elias, Acabe lhe disse: "[É] você, perturbador de Israel?"
pt.B: Quando Acabe viu Elias, disse-lhe: "É você, o perturbador de Israel?"
pt.R: Assim que Acabe viu Elias, disse a ele: "Então é você, o homem que traz desgraça sobre Israel!"

am.L: አክዓብም ኤልያስን ባየው ጊዜ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ አክዓብ፦ «የእስራኤል አስጨናቂ፣ ይህ አንተ ነህን?» አለው።
am.B: አክዓብ ኤልያስን ባየው ጊዜ፦ «አንተ የእስራኤል አስጨናቂ፣ አንተ ነህን?» አለው።
am.R: አክዓብ ኤልያስን እንዳየው፦ «በእስራኤል ላይ መከራ የምታመጣው ሰው፣ ለካ አንተ ነህ!» አለው።

hi.L: और जब अहाब ने एलिय्याह को देखा, तो अहाब ने उससे कहा, "क्या तुम हो, इस्राएल को कष्ट देनेवाले?"
hi.B: जब अहाब ने एलिय्याह को देखा, तो उससे कहा, "क्या यह तुम हो, इस्राएल को संकट में डालनेवाले?"
hi.R: एलिय्याह को देखते ही अहाब ने उससे कहा, "तो तुम ही हो, वह आदमी जो इस्राएल पर मुसीबत लाया है!"

ru.L: И было, когда Ахав увидел Илию, сказал ему Ахав: «Ты ли это, смущающий Израиль?»
ru.B: Увидев Илию, Ахав сказал ему: «Это ты, губитель Израиля?»
ru.R: Как только Ахав увидел Илию, он сказал ему: «Так это ты, тот, кто навлёк беду на Израиль!»

uk.L: І було, як побачив Ахав Іллю, то сказав йому Ахав: «Чи це ти, той, що наводить біду на Ізраїль?»
uk.B: Коли Ахав побачив Іллю, він сказав йому: «Це ти, той, хто наводить біду на Ізраїль?»
uk.R: Щойно Ахав побачив Іллю, він сказав йому: «Отже, це ти, той, хто наводить біду на Ізраїль!»

decisions.choice: troubler of Israel: one who brings disaster on the whole people
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring ruin or disaster on a community. It is the word Joshua used to Achan, whose sin brought defeat on Israel: "Why have you troubled us? Yahweh will trouble you today" (Joshua 7:25). Ahab blames the drought on Elijah as if he were another Achan.

decisions.choice: is it you?: an accusation, not a question
decisions.reason: Obadiah used the same words in respect (verse 7: "Is it you, my lord Elijah?"). In Ahab's mouth they are a charge. The contrast shows the two men's attitudes to the prophet.

decisions.choice: troubler (Literal, Balanced); the man who brings trouble on (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Troubler" is rare in English; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "perturbador de Israel" (L); "el que perturba a Israel" (B); "el hombre que le trae problemas a Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of Achan, who brought disaster on Israel (Joshua 7:25); Spanish "perturbar" carries the sense of bringing ruin, and Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "fléau d’Israël" (L); "toi qui jettes le trouble en Israël" (B); "toi qui attires le malheur sur Israël" (R)
decisions.reason: French has no single noun as plain as the Hebrew "troubler"; Literal says "fléau", one who brings ruin, and Balanced and Readable use the verb. Elijah’s answer in verse 18 takes up "trouble".

decisions.choice: mtaabishaji (Literal, Balanced); mtu anayeleta taabu (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Mtaabishaji" (one who brings trouble on others) keeps the link with Elijah's reply, "sikumtaabisha Israeli", which uses the same verb.

decisions.choice: Ahab calls Elijah "ông", even in anger
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "ông" for the king speaking to a prophet; the hostility is carried by "kẻ làm rối loạn", not by a rude pronoun.

decisions.choice: Ahab speaks to Elijah in 해라체
decisions.reason: The king speaks down to the prophet he blames for the drought; the hostile 해라체 marks the accusation the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: o perturbador de Israel (L, B); o homem que traz desgraça sobre Israel (R); você (Ahab and Elijah)
alternatives: o causador de desgraças de Israel
decisions.reason: "Perturbador" is the Portuguese noun for one who brings trouble on a community, and Literal and Balanced keep it as a title, with "perturbar" in Elijah's answer (verse 18). Readable says "trazer desgraça", the words of Joshua 7:25 in Portuguese, the verse this one recalls (m1). Ahab and Elijah speak to each other with "você": the king does not honour the prophet, and the prophet speaks to him as an equal before the LORD.

decisions.choice: troubler of Israel "የእስራኤል አስጨናቂ" (Literal, Balanced), with "ያስጨነቅኩ" in verse 18; Readable "በእስራኤል ላይ መከራ የምታመጣው"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use one root for Ahab's charge and Elijah's answer, as the Hebrew does, so the reply turns the word back on the king.

decisions.choice: Ahab says "तुम" to Elijah; Elijah says "आप" to Ahab
decisions.reason: A king speaks down to his subject, and with hostility here (meaning m2). Elijah keeps "आप" for the king, as Nathan to David in 2 Samuel 12:7 ("वह पुरुष आप ही हैं!"); the rebuke is in his words, not in the pronoun. Held through 1 Kings 17-21.

decisions.choice: "смущающий Израиль" (L); "губитель Израиля" (B); "тот, кто навлёк беду" (R)
decisions.reason: Ahab's charge is that Elijah brings ruin on the nation; Balanced uses a strong noun, Readable explains. The same root returns in Elijah's answer (18:18), where the verb follows each level's choice.

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לֹ֤א עָכַ֨רְתִּי֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י אִם־אַתָּ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית אָבִ֑יךָ בַּֽעֲזָבְכֶם֙ אֶת־מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַבְּעָלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Not have I troubled Israel, but rather you and [the] house of your father, in your forsaking [the] commandments of Yahweh, and you have walked after the Baals.

en.L: And he said, "I have not troubled Israel, but you and the house of your father [have], in your forsaking the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and you have walked after the Baals.
en.B: Elijah answered, "I have not brought trouble on Israel. You have, you and your father's house, because you have abandoned {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s commandments and followed the Baals.
en.R: Elijah answered, "I am not the one who has brought trouble on Israel. You and your father's family have done that. You have turned away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s commands and have worshiped the Baals instead.

es.L: Y él dijo: «No he perturbado yo a Israel, sino tú y la casa de tu padre, al dejar los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y has andado tras los baales.
es.B: Elías respondió: «No he sido yo quien ha perturbado a Israel, sino tú y la casa de tu padre, porque {{plural_you:han abandonado|habéis abandonado}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y has seguido a los baales.
es.R: Elías respondió: «Yo no soy el que le ha traído problemas a Israel. Han sido tú y la familia de tu padre. {{plural_you:Ustedes se han apartado|Vosotros os habéis apartado}} de los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y tú has adorado a los baales.

fr.L: Et il dit : « Ce n’est pas moi qui ai troublé Israël, mais toi et la maison de ton père, en abandonnant les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et tu as marché derrière les Baals.
fr.B: Élie répondit : « Ce n’est pas moi qui ai jeté le trouble en Israël. C’est toi et la maison de ton père, parce que vous avez abandonné les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et que tu as suivi les Baals.
fr.R: Élie a répondu : « Ce n’est pas moi qui ai attiré le malheur sur Israël. C’est toi et la famille de ton père. Vous avez abandonné les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et toi, tu as adoré les Baals à la place.

sw.L: Akasema, "Mimi sikumtaabisha Israeli, bali wewe na nyumba ya baba yako, kwa kuziacha kwenu amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nawe umeyafuata Mabaali.
sw.B: Eliya akajibu, "Sikumletea Israeli taabu. Wewe ndiye uliyefanya hivyo, wewe na nyumba ya baba yako, kwa sababu mmeziacha amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuyafuata Mabaali.
sw.R: Eliya akajibu, "Mimi siye niliyeleta taabu juu ya Israeli. Wewe na jamaa ya baba yako ndio mliofanya hivyo. Mmeziacha amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkayaabudu Mabaali badala yake.

vi.L: Ông đáp: "Tôi không làm rối loạn Y-sơ-ra-ên, nhưng chính vua và nhà cha vua [đã làm], vì các người đã lìa bỏ các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và vua đã đi theo các Ba-anh.
vi.B: Ê-li đáp: "Không phải tôi làm khốn đốn Y-sơ-ra-ên, mà chính vua và nhà cha vua, vì các người đã lìa bỏ các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đi theo các Ba-anh.
vi.R: Ê-li trả lời: "Không phải tôi đem tai họa đến cho Y-sơ-ra-ên. Chính vua và gia đình cha vua đã làm điều đó. Các người đã quay lưng với các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đi thờ các thần Ba-anh.

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "내가 이스라엘을 괴롭힌 것이 아니라, 당신과 당신 아버지의 집이 [괴롭혔소]. 당신들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계명을 버리고, 당신은 바알들을 따라갔기 때문이오.
ko.B: 엘리야가 대답했다. "내가 이스라엘을 괴롭힌 것이 아니오. 당신과 당신 아버지의 집안이 괴롭혔소. 당신들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계명을 버리고 바알들을 따랐기 때문이오.
ko.R: 엘리야가 대답했다. "이스라엘에 재앙을 가져온 사람은 내가 아니오. 당신과 당신 아버지의 집안이 그렇게 했소. 당신들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 저버리고, 오히려 바알들을 섬겼소.

pt.L: E ele disse: "Eu não perturbei Israel, mas você e a casa do seu pai, por abandonarem os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; e você andou após os baalins.
pt.B: Elias respondeu: "Não fui eu que perturbei Israel. Foram você e a família do seu pai, porque abandonaram os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e você seguiu os baalins.
pt.R: Elias respondeu: "Não sou eu quem traz desgraça sobre Israel. Foram você e a família do seu pai que fizeram isso. Vocês deixaram de lado os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e passaram a adorar os baalins.

am.L: እርሱም አለ፦ «እስራኤልን ያስጨነቅኩ እኔ አይደለሁም፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት በመተዋችሁ አንተና የአባትህ ቤት [ናችሁ] እንጂ፤ አንተም በኣሊምን ተከትለህ ሄድህ።
am.B: ኤልያስም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰ፦ «እስራኤልን ያስጨነቅኩ እኔ አይደለሁም፤ ያስጨነቃችሁት አንተና የአባትህ ቤት ናችሁ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ትታችኋልና፤ አንተም በኣሊምን ተከትለሃል።
am.R: ኤልያስም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰ፦ «በእስራኤል ላይ መከራ ያመጣሁት እኔ አይደለሁም። ይህን ያደረጋችሁት አንተና የአባትህ ቤተሰብ ናችሁ። {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ትታችኋል፤ በምትኩም አንተ በኣሊምን አምልከሃል።

hi.L: और उसने कहा, "इस्राएल को मैंने कष्ट नहीं दिया, पर आपने और आपके पिता के घराने ने, क्योंकि आपने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञाओं को त्याग दिया, और आप बाल देवताओं के पीछे चले हैं।
hi.B: एलिय्याह ने उत्तर दिया, "इस्राएल को संकट में मैंने नहीं डाला, बल्कि आपने और आपके पिता के घराने ने डाला है, क्योंकि आपने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञाएँ त्याग दीं और बाल देवताओं के पीछे चले।
hi.R: एलिय्याह ने उत्तर दिया, "इस्राएल पर मुसीबत लानेवाला मैं नहीं हूँ। यह आपने और आपके पिता के परिवार ने किया है। आपने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञाओं से मुँह मोड़ लिया है और उनके बदले बाल देवताओं की पूजा की है।

ru.L: И сказал он: «Не я смутил Израиль, а ты и дом твоего отца, тем, что вы оставили заповеди {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и ты пошёл вслед ваалов.
ru.B: Илия ответил: «Не я погубил Израиль, а ты и дом твоего отца, потому что вы оставили заповеди {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и ты пошёл за ваалами.
ru.R: Илия ответил: «Не я навлёк беду на Израиль, а ты и семья твоего отца. Вы отвернулись от заповедей {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и ты стал поклоняться ваалам.

uk.L: І сказав той: «Не я навів біду на Ізраїль, а ти і дім твого батька, тим, що ви покинули заповіді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; і ти ходив за Ваалами.
uk.B: Ілля відповів: «Не я навів біду на Ізраїль. Ти навів, ти і дім твого батька, бо ви покинули заповіді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і пішли за Ваалами.
uk.R: Ілля відповів: «Не я навожу біду на Ізраїль. Це зробили ти і родина твого батька. Ви відвернулися від заповідей {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і натомість почали поклонятися Ваалам.

decisions.choice: the troubler is Ahab: disobedience brought the drought
decisions.reason: Elijah turns the charge back on the king. The law warned that if Israel turned to other gods, Yahweh would shut the sky and there would be no rain (Deuteronomy 11:16-17). The drought is the result of Ahab's sin, not of Elijah's word.

decisions.choice: your father's house: the dynasty of Omri
decisions.reason: Ahab's father Omri did evil, more than all before him (16:25-26), and Ahab went further still (16:30-33).

decisions.choice: the Baals: Baal in his many local forms and images
decisions.reason: The plural is used for Baal as worshiped at many shrines and under many local titles (Judges 2:11; 1 Samuel 7:4). To walk after them is to worship and serve them.

decisions.choice: you have forsaken (plural) ... you have walked (singular)
decisions.reason: "Your forsaking" speaks to Ahab and his family together; "you have walked" turns back to Ahab himself.

decisions.choice: commandments (Literal, Balanced); commands (Readable); followed (Balanced); worshiped (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this word in these books. Balanced and Readable say what "walk after" means. Elijah's speech goes on into verse 19.

decisions.choice: "los baales"
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Samuel: the plural for Baal in his many local forms.

decisions.choice: "vous avez abandonné ... tu as suivi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: French can show what the English cannot: the forsaking is said of Ahab and his house together (plural), the following of the Baals of Ahab himself (m4).

decisions.choice: Mabaali
decisions.reason: The plural "the Baals" (Baal in his many local forms) is "Mabaali", as the Swahili of 1 Samuel has it.

decisions.choice: "các Ba-anh" (L, B); "các thần Ba-anh" (R)
decisions.reason: The plural names Baal in his many local forms, as the Samuel drafts have "các Ba-anh"; Readable adds "thần".

decisions.choice: os baalins
decisions.reason: The plural (m3) keeps "os baalins" of Judges 2:11 and 1 Samuel 7:4 in Portuguese, for the whole book; the one god is "Baal".

decisions.choice: "በመተዋችሁ" / "ትታችኋልና" (plural) ... "አንተም ... ተከትለህ ሄድህ" (singular)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from "you" plural (Ahab and his father's house) to "you" singular (Ahab); Amharic marks the number on the verb and keeps the turn.

decisions.choice: "बाल देवताओं" (the Baals)
decisions.reason: Baal in his many local forms (meaning m3): "बाल देवता" in the plural, as the history terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "ваалы"
decisions.reason: The plural Baals as the history terms note sets; the singular god keeps Ваал as Romans 11:4.

decisions.choice: Mount Carmel: the ridge running to the sea in the northwest
decisions.reason: Carmel is a long, high ridge that ends at the Mediterranean, on the border between Israel and the Phoenician lands of Jezebel's father (16:31). It was green and fertile and had altars of its own (verse 30).

decisions.choice: Asherah: a Canaanite goddess
decisions.reason: Here Asherah is the goddess herself, not the wooden pole that stood for her (16:33). She was worshiped alongside Baal. Her prophets are not mentioned again in the chapter; only the prophets of Baal take part in the contest (verses 22, 25, 40).

decisions.choice: who eat at Jezebel's table: kept at the queen's expense
decisions.reason: To eat at a ruler's table was to be supported from the royal household (2 Samuel 9:7; 1 Kings 2:7). These prophets were Jezebel's own, paid by the court, while Yahweh's prophets hid in caves (verse 4).

decisions.choice: the goddess Asherah; send messengers (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says that Asherah was a goddess, so she is not taken for a person.

decisions.choice: "el monte Carmelo"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms table's form for the mountain, kept apart from the town of Carmel in Judah (1 Samuel 25).

decisions.choice: "núi Cạt-mên"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form of Mount Carmel.

decisions.choice: o monte Carmelo; Aserá (the goddess); quatrocentos e cinquenta
decisions.reason: Here Asherah is the goddess herself (m2), so she is "Aserá" without "os postes", which the book keeps for the wooden poles; Readable adds "a deusa", as the English does and as Judges 6:25 does in Portuguese. "Carmelo" is the usual Brazilian form. Literal keeps the Hebrew article, "o Baal", as 16:31 does in Portuguese. The counts are round tens and hundreds, so Portuguese writes them in words (docs/portuguese-style.md section 5).

decisions.choice: Asherah "አሼራ"; Readable "አሼራ የምትባለው ሴት አምላክ"
decisions.reason: The form of Deuteronomy and Exodus 34:13; Readable explains, as it does there, that Asherah is a goddess.

decisions.choice: Mount Carmel "कर्मेल पहाड़"; Asherah "अशेरा" (R "अशेरा देवी")
decisions.reason: Carmel as in 1 Samuel 25 ("कर्मेल"), with "पहाड़" as "गिलबो पहाड़"; Asherah as the history terms note.

decisions.choice: "гора Кармил"; "Ашера"
decisions.reason: Carmel as Joshua and 1 Samuel 25 in this translation; Asherah as the history terms note.

decisions.choice: numbers in words
decisions.reason: Round numbers in running text are written in words, as 2 Samuel in this translation does.

uk.L: І послав Ахав по всіх {{gender:нащадках Ізраїля|синах Ізраїля}}, і зібрав пророків на горі Кармел.
uk.B: Тож Ахав послав звістку всім ізраїльтянам і зібрав пророків на горі Кармел.
uk.R: Тож Ахав послав звістку всім ізраїльтянам. Він зібрав пророків на горі Кармел.

decisions.choice: Ahab sent ... and gathered: the king obeys the prophet
decisions.reason: Ahab does exactly what Elijah told him (verse 19), without a word. The king who called Elijah a troubler now carries out his orders.

decisions.choice: the prophets: the prophets of Baal
decisions.reason: The prophets gathered are those Elijah named, the prophets of Baal (and of Asherah). The people of Israel are summoned too (verse 21).

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender span
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Israel
decisions.reason: As in the Old Testament terms and 6:1 in Portuguese: "filhos de Israel" and "israelitas" already take in women and men, so Portuguese has no second wording for the English gender setting.

decisions.choice: "የእስራኤል ልጆች" (Literal, Balanced); "እስራኤላውያን" (Readable), with no gender span
alternatives: gender spans like the English ones
decisions.reason: Amharic "ልጆች" already includes daughters, and "እስራኤላውያን" is the whole people, so there is no second wording for the setting to switch to (as the Pentateuch terms list). This holds for 1 Kings 18-19.

decisions.choice: "इस्राएलियों" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms note: Literal has the span "इस्राएल की सन्तान" / "इस्राएल के पुत्र"; Balanced and Readable say "इस्राएली", which already covers men and women, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "израильтяне" without a gender span (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch terms note sets израильтяне at Balanced and Readable, already inclusive, so the English span is not needed there.

source.text: וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֶל־כָּל־הָעָ֗ם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ עַד־מָתַ֞י אַתֶּ֣ם פֹּסְחִים֮ עַל־שְׁתֵּ֣י הַסְּעִפִּים֒ אִם־יְהוָ֤ה הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לְכ֣וּ אַחֲרָ֔יו וְאִם־הַבַּ֖עַל לְכ֣וּ אַחֲרָ֑יו וְלֹֽא־עָנ֥וּ הָעָ֛ם אֹת֖וֹ דָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And came near Elijah to all the people and said, Until when [are] you limping on [the] two the branches? If Yahweh [is] the God, walk after him; and if the Baal, walk after him. And not answered the people him a word.

en.L: And Elijah came near to all the people and said, "How long [are] you limping on the two branches? If {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] God, walk after {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; and if Baal, walk after him." And the people did not answer him a word.
en.B: Elijah stepped up before all the people and said, "How long will you go on hobbling between two choices? If {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is God, follow {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. If it is Baal, follow Baal." But the people said nothing in reply.
en.R: Elijah came up to all the people and said, "How long are you going to keep switching back and forth between two sides? If {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is the true God, follow {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! But if Baal is God, then follow Baal!" But the people did not say a word.

es.L: Y Elías se acercó a todo el pueblo y dijo: «¿Hasta cuándo {{plural_you:cojearán|cojearéis}} sobre las dos ramas? Si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] Dios, {{plural_you:anden|andad}} tras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; y si Baal, {{plural_you:anden|andad}} tras él». Y el pueblo no le respondió palabra.
es.B: Elías se presentó ante todo el pueblo y dijo: «¿Hasta cuándo {{plural_you:seguirán|seguiréis}} cojeando entre dos opciones? Si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Dios, {{plural_you:síganlo|seguidlo}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Si es Baal, {{plural_you:sigan|seguid}} a Baal». Pero el pueblo no respondió nada.
es.R: Elías se acercó a todo el pueblo y dijo: «¿Hasta cuándo {{plural_you:van|vais}} a seguir yendo de un lado a otro? Si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el Dios verdadero, ¡{{plural_you:síganlo|seguidlo}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}! Pero si Baal es Dios, ¡entonces {{plural_you:sigan|seguid}} a Baal!». Pero el pueblo no dijo ni una palabra.

fr.L: Et Élie s’approcha de tout le peuple et dit : « Jusqu’à quand boiterez-vous des deux côtés ? Si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] Dieu, marchez derrière {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; et si [c’est] Baal, marchez derrière lui. » Et le peuple ne lui répondit pas un mot.
fr.B: Élie s’avança devant tout le peuple et dit : « Jusqu’à quand clocherez-vous entre deux choix ? Si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est Dieu, suivez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. Si c’est Baal, suivez Baal. » Mais le peuple ne lui répondit rien.
fr.R: Élie s’est approché de tout le peuple et il a dit : « Combien de temps allez-vous encore hésiter entre deux camps ? Si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est le vrai Dieu, suivez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! Mais si c’est Baal qui est Dieu, alors suivez Baal ! » Mais le peuple n’a pas dit un mot.

sw.L: Eliya akawakaribia watu wote, akasema, "Mpaka lini [mtakuwa] mkichechemea juu ya matawi mawili? Ikiwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ndiye] Mungu, mfuateni; na ikiwa ni Baali, mfuateni yeye." Watu hawakumjibu neno.
sw.B: Eliya akasimama mbele ya watu wote, akasema, "Mpaka lini mtaendelea kuchechemea kati ya njia mbili? Ikiwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye Mungu, mfuateni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}. Ikiwa ni Baali, mfuateni Baali." Lakini watu hawakujibu neno.
sw.R: Eliya akawaendea watu wote, akasema, "Mpaka lini mtaendelea kuyumba huku na huku kati ya pande mbili? Ikiwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye Mungu wa kweli, mfuateni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}! Lakini ikiwa Baali ndiye Mungu, basi mfuateni Baali!" Lakini watu hawakusema neno.

vi.L: Ê-li đến gần cả dân chúng và nói: "Các người khập khiễng trên hai nhánh cho đến bao giờ? Nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời, hãy đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; còn nếu Ba-anh [là thần], hãy đi theo nó." Dân chúng không đáp lại ông một lời.
vi.B: Ê-li bước đến trước toàn dân và nói: "Các người cứ lưỡng lự giữa hai đường cho đến bao giờ? Nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời, hãy theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Còn nếu Ba-anh là thần, hãy theo Ba-anh." Nhưng dân chúng không đáp lại một lời nào.
vi.R: Ê-li đến gần toàn dân và nói: "Các người còn ngả nghiêng giữa hai bên cho đến bao giờ? Nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời thật, hãy theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Còn nếu Ba-anh là thần thật, thì hãy theo Ba-anh!" Nhưng dân chúng không nói một lời nào.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리야가 모든 백성에게 가까이 가서 말했다. "너희가 언제까지 두 가지 사이에서 절뚝거리겠느냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하나님이시면 그분을 따라 걷고, 바알이 [하나님이면] 그를 따라 걸어라." 그러나 백성은 그에게 한마디도 대답하지 않았다.
ko.B: 엘리야가 모든 백성 앞에 나아가 말했다. "너희가 언제까지 두 생각 사이에서 머뭇거리겠느냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하나님이시면 그분을 따르고, 바알이 하나님이면 바알을 따라라." 그러나 백성은 아무 대답도 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 엘리야가 모든 백성에게 다가가 말했다. "너희는 언제까지 이쪽저쪽 오락가락하겠느냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 참 하나님이시면 그분을 따라라! 그러나 바알이 하나님이면 바알을 따라라!" 그러나 백성은 한마디도 하지 않았다.

pt.L: E Elias se aproximou de todo o povo e disse: "Até quando vocês [ficarão] mancando sobre os dois galhos? Se {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é] Deus, andem após {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}; e, se [é] o Baal, andem após ele." E o povo não lhe respondeu uma palavra.
pt.B: Elias se colocou diante de todo o povo e disse: "Até quando vocês vão ficar mancando entre duas opiniões? Se {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é Deus, sigam-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}. Se é Baal, sigam Baal." Mas o povo não respondeu nada.
pt.R: Elias se aproximou de todo o povo e disse: "Até quando vocês vão ficar indecisos, sem escolher um lado? Se {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é o Deus verdadeiro, sigam-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}! Mas, se Baal é Deus, então sigam Baal!" Mas o povo não disse uma só palavra.

am.L: ኤልያስም ወደ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ቀርቦ፦ «በሁለቱ ቅርንጫፎች ላይ እስከ መቼ ታነክሳላችሁ? {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላክ ከሆነ እርሱን ተከትላችሁ ሂዱ፤ በኣልም ከሆነ እርሱን ተከትላችሁ ሂዱ» አለ። ሕዝቡም አንድ ቃል አልመለሱለትም።
am.B: ኤልያስ በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት ቀርቦ፦ «እስከ መቼ በሁለት ምርጫ መካከል እያነከሳችሁ ትቆያላችሁ? {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላክ ከሆነ እርሱን ተከተሉ። በኣል ከሆነ ግን በኣልን ተከተሉ» አለ። ሕዝቡ ግን አንዳች አልመለሱለትም።
am.R: ኤልያስ ወደ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ቀርቦ፦ «እስከ መቼ በሁለት ወገን መካከል ወዲያና ወዲህ ትወላወላላችሁ? {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እውነተኛው አምላክ ከሆነ እርሱን ተከተሉ! በኣል አምላክ ከሆነ ግን በኣልን ተከተሉ!» አለ። ሕዝቡ ግን አንድ ቃል አልተናገሩም።

hi.L: और एलिय्याह सब लोगों के पास आकर बोला, "तुम कब तक दो डालियों पर लंगड़ाते रहोगे? यदि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} परमेश्वर [हैं], तो उनके पीछे चलो; और यदि बाल, तो उसके पीछे चलो।" पर लोगों ने उसे एक शब्द भी उत्तर न दिया।
hi.B: एलिय्याह सब लोगों के सामने आकर बोला, "तुम कब तक दो विचारों के बीच डगमगाते रहोगे? यदि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} परमेश्वर हैं, तो उनके पीछे चलो। और यदि बाल है, तो बाल के पीछे चलो।" पर लोगों ने उसे कुछ भी उत्तर न दिया।
hi.R: एलिय्याह सब लोगों के पास आया और बोला, "तुम कब तक कभी इस ओर और कभी उस ओर होते रहोगे? अगर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही सच्चे परमेश्वर हैं, तो उनके पीछे चलो! पर अगर बाल परमेश्वर है, तो बाल के पीछे चलो!" पर लोगों ने एक शब्द भी नहीं कहा।

ru.L: И подошёл Илия ко всему народу и сказал: «Доколе вы будете хромать на два колена? Если {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Бог, идите вслед за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}; а если Ваал, идите вслед за ним.» И не ответил ему народ ни слова.
ru.B: Илия выступил перед всем народом и сказал: «Сколько ещё вы будете метаться между двумя мнениями? Если {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Бог, следуйте за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}. А если Ваал, следуйте за Ваалом.» Но народ не ответил ему ни слова.
ru.R: Илия подошёл ко всему народу и сказал: «Сколько вы ещё будете метаться туда и сюда между двумя сторонами? Если {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — истинный Бог, идите за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}! А если Бог — Ваал, то идите за Ваалом!» Но народ молчал.

uk.L: І підійшов Ілля до всього народу, і сказав: «Доки ви кульгатимете на обидві гілки? Якщо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — Бог, ідіть за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}; а якщо Ваал, ідіть за ним». І не відповів йому народ ні слова.
uk.B: Ілля вийшов перед увесь народ і сказав: «Доки ви шкутильгатимете між двома думками? Якщо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — Бог, ідіть за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}. Якщо ж Ваал, ідіть за Ваалом». Але народ не відповів ні слова.
uk.R: Ілля підійшов до всього народу і сказав: «Доки ви хитатиметеся то в один бік, то в другий? Якщо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — справжній Бог, ідіть за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}! А якщо Бог — Ваал, то йдіть за Ваалом!» Але народ не сказав ні слова.

decisions.choice: limping on the two branches: wavering, unable to commit to either side
decisions.reason: The verb means to limp or hobble. The noun is rare; it is related to words for branches or divided boughs, and to a word for divided thoughts (Psalm 119:113). The picture may be of a man limping because he walks on two different crutches, of a bird hopping from branch to branch, or simply of someone who cannot choose between two opinions. Every reading gives the same point: Israel cannot keep a foot in both camps.

decisions.choice: God: the true God, the one who is really God
decisions.reason: The word has the article, "the God". The question is not whether Yahweh or Baal is a god but which of them is God in truth. The same words return in the people's cry in verse 39.

decisions.choice: walk after him: follow and worship him
decisions.reason: To walk after a god is to be his loyal follower (Deuteronomy 13:5; verse 18).

decisions.choice: limping: echoed in verse 26
decisions.reason: The same verb describes the prophets of Baal hobbling around their altar (verse 26). Israel's wavering is like their limping dance.

decisions.choice: limping on the two branches (Literal); hobbling between two choices (Balanced); switching back and forth between two sides (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture. Balanced keeps the limping and gives the sense of the rare noun. Readable says plainly what the saying means.

decisions.choice: the true God; Baal is God (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the contrast and repeats the name Baal to make clear who is followed.

decisions.choice: "cojearán sobre las dos ramas" (L); "cojeando entre dos opciones" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of limping on two branches, which verse 26 echoes; Balanced keeps the limping and names the two choices; Readable gives the sense.

decisions.choice: "boiterez-vous des deux côtés" (L); "clocherez-vous entre deux choix" (B); "hésiter entre deux camps" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the limping on two sides; Balanced keeps the limp ("clocher") with the sense, which links to the prophets’ "hobbling" in verse 26; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: kuchechemea juu ya matawi mawili (Literal); kuchechemea kati ya njia mbili (Balanced); kuyumba huku na huku kati ya pande mbili (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Kuchechemea" (to limp) is kept at Literal and Balanced so that it echoes the limping dance of Baal's prophets in verse 26.

decisions.choice: mfuateni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add the free pronoun "yeye" for the LORD so that the span stands where the English has one; Literal says only "mfuateni", with no span.

decisions.choice: Elijah calls the wavering people "các người"
decisions.reason: Elijah rebukes the crowd; "các người" keeps a distance that "anh em" would soften.

decisions.choice: "khập khiễng trên hai nhánh" (L); "lưỡng lự giữa hai đường" (B); "ngả nghiêng giữa hai bên" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of limping, which returns in verse 26; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: Elijah speaks to the people and to Baal's prophets in 해라체
decisions.reason: A prophet addressing the assembled people speaks with authority, as Samuel does in the Korean 1 Samuel.

decisions.choice: "두 가지 사이에서 절뚝거리다" (L), "머뭇거리다" (B), "오락가락하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the limping that verse 26 picks up ("절뚝거리며"); Balanced and Readable say what it means. The Korean idiom "양다리를 걸치다" was set aside because it suggests deceit rather than indecision.

decisions.choice: mancando sobre os dois galhos (L); mancando entre duas opiniões (B); ficar indecisos, sem escolher um lado (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of limping on two branches (m1). Balanced keeps the limp, which returns in the prophets' dance (verse 26, m4), and gives the rare noun its sense of divided thoughts with "opiniões"; "mancar" is the everyday Brazilian verb, where "coxear" is literary. Readable says plainly what the saying means, as the English does. The people are "vocês".

decisions.choice: "በሁለቱ ቅርንጫፎች ላይ እስከ መቼ ታነክሳላችሁ?" (Literal); "እስከ መቼ በሁለት ምርጫ መካከል እያነከሳችሁ ትቆያላችሁ?" (Balanced); "እስከ መቼ በሁለት ወገን መካከል ወዲያና ወዲህ ትወላወላላችሁ?" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the English levels: Literal keeps the picture of limping on two branches, Balanced keeps the limping ("ማነከስ", the verb of verse 26) and gives the sense of the rare noun as "choices", Readable says what the saying means. The wording familiar from older Amharic Bibles is not reused.

decisions.choice: God (ha-Elohim) as a predicate: "አምላክ" ("{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላክ ከሆነ"; verses 24, 37, 39); Readable "እውነተኛው አምላክ"
decisions.reason: The question is which one is God, and "እግዚአብሔር" already renders the divine name, so "⟨N⟩ እግዚአብሔር ከሆነ" would say nothing; the style guide keeps "አምላክ" where Elohim is a predicate.

decisions.choice: "दो डालियों पर लंगड़ाते" (L); "दो विचारों के बीच डगमगाते" (B); "कभी इस ओर और कभी उस ओर होते" (R)
decisions.reason: Wavering between two sides (meaning m1); Literal keeps the picture of the limping that returns in verse 26.

decisions.choice: Elijah says "तुम" to the people and to the prophets of Baal
decisions.reason: A prophet addressing the crowd and his opponents; Baal is spoken of with plain forms ("उसके", "है"), God with honorific ones ("उनके", "हैं").

decisions.choice: "хромать на два колена" (L); "метаться между двумя мнениями" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew image is uncertain (branches, opinions); Literal keeps limping with колено, which in Russian can be a knee or a bend (close to the familiar Synodal phrase, a short traditional idiom); the other levels say what is meant.

decisions.choice: "кульгатимете на обидві гілки" (L), "шкутильгатимете між двома думками" (B), with the verb of limping kept so that verse 26 can echo it
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes the echo in verse 26, where the prophets of Baal limp around the altar; L and B keep a limping verb in both places.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם אֲנִ֞י נוֹתַ֧רְתִּי נָבִ֛יא לַיהוָ֖ה לְבַדִּ֑י וּנְבִיאֵ֣י הַבַּ֔עַל אַרְבַּע־מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים אִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Elijah to the people, I, I am left a prophet of Yahweh, I by myself, and [the] prophets of the Baal [are] four hundred and fifty man.

en.L: And Elijah said to the people, "I, I am left a prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I alone, and the prophets of Baal [are] 450 men.
en.B: Then Elijah said to the people, "I am the only one left of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s prophets, but Baal has 450 prophets.
en.R: Then Elijah told the people, "I am the only prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who is left. But Baal has 450 prophets.

es.L: Y Elías dijo al pueblo: «Yo, yo he quedado como profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, yo solo, y los profetas de Baal [son] 450 hombres.
es.B: Luego Elías le dijo al pueblo: «Yo soy el único que queda de los profetas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, pero Baal tiene 450 profetas.
es.R: Luego Elías le dijo al pueblo: «Yo soy el único profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que queda. Pero Baal tiene 450 profetas.

fr.L: Et Élie dit au peuple : « Moi, je suis resté prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, moi seul, et les prophètes de Baal [sont] 450 hommes.
fr.B: Élie dit alors au peuple : « Je suis le seul prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui reste, mais les prophètes de Baal sont 450.
fr.R: Ensuite Élie a dit au peuple : « Je suis le seul prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui reste. Mais Baal a 450 prophètes.

sw.L: Eliya akawaambia watu, "Mimi, mimi nimebaki nabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mimi peke yangu, na manabii wa Baali [ni] watu 450.
sw.B: Kisha Eliya akawaambia watu, "Mimi peke yangu ndiye niliyebaki kati ya manabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini Baali ana manabii 450.
sw.R: Kisha Eliya akawaambia watu, "Mimi ndiye nabii pekee wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyebaki. Lakini Baali ana manabii 450.

vi.L: Ê-li nói với dân chúng: "Tôi, chỉ còn lại một mình tôi là nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, còn các nhà tiên tri của Ba-anh [thì có] bốn trăm năm mươi người.
vi.B: Rồi Ê-li nói với dân chúng: "Trong các nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chỉ còn lại một mình tôi, còn Ba-anh có đến 450 nhà tiên tri.
vi.R: Rồi Ê-li nói với dân chúng: "Tôi là nhà tiên tri duy nhất của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} còn lại. Còn Ba-anh có đến 450 nhà tiên tri.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리야가 백성에게 말했다. "나, 나만 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자로 남았다. 나 혼자다. 그러나 바알의 예언자들은 450명이다.
ko.B: 엘리야가 백성에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자로는 나 혼자 남았다. 그러나 바알의 예언자는 450명이다.
ko.R: 엘리야가 백성에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자 가운데 남은 사람은 나 하나뿐이다. 그러나 바알의 예언자는 450명이나 된다.

pt.L: E Elias disse ao povo: "Eu, eu fiquei [como] profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, eu sozinho, e os profetas do Baal [são] quatrocentos e cinquenta homens.
pt.B: Então Elias disse ao povo: "Sou o único que restou dos profetas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, mas Baal tem quatrocentos e cinquenta profetas.
pt.R: Então Elias disse ao povo: "Eu sou o único profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que ficou. Mas Baal tem quatrocentos e cinquenta profetas.

am.L: ኤልያስም ሕዝቡን አለ፦ «እኔ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ነቢይ ሆኜ እኔ ብቻዬን ቀርቻለሁ፤ የበኣልም ነቢያት 450 ሰዎች ናቸው።
am.B: ከዚያም ኤልያስ ሕዝቡን እንዲህ አለ፦ «{{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ነቢያት የቀረሁት እኔ ብቻ ነኝ፤ በኣል ግን 450 ነቢያት አሉት።
am.R: ከዚያም ኤልያስ ሕዝቡን እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «የቀረሁት ብቸኛው {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ነቢይ እኔ ነኝ። በኣል ግን 450 ነቢያት አሉት።

hi.L: और एलिय्याह ने लोगों से कहा, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भविष्यद्वक्ता बचा हुआ मैं, केवल मैं ही हूँ, और बाल के भविष्यद्वक्ता साढ़े चार सौ पुरुष [हैं]।
hi.B: तब एलिय्याह ने लोगों से कहा, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भविष्यद्वक्ताओं में से केवल मैं ही बचा हूँ, पर बाल के 450 भविष्यद्वक्ता हैं।
hi.R: तब एलिय्याह ने लोगों से कहा, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का केवल मैं ही एक नबी बचा हूँ। पर बाल के 450 नबी हैं।

ru.L: И сказал Илия народу: «Я, я остался пророком {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, я один, а пророков Ваала — четыреста пятьдесят человек.
ru.B: Тогда Илия сказал народу: «Из пророков {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} остался я один, а у Ваала четыреста пятьдесят пророков.
ru.R: Тогда Илия сказал народу: «Я единственный пророк {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, который остался. А у Ваала четыреста пятьдесят пророков.

uk.L: І сказав Ілля народові: «Я, я один залишився пророком {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, я сам, а пророків Ваала — 450 чоловік.
uk.B: Тоді Ілля сказав народові: «Я єдиний, хто залишився з пророків {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, а в Ваала 450 пророків.
uk.R: Тоді Ілля сказав народові: «Я єдиний пророк {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, який залишився. А в Ваала 450 пророків.

decisions.choice: I alone am left: the only prophet of Yahweh standing here
decisions.reason: Obadiah had hidden a hundred prophets of Yahweh (verses 4, 13), so Elijah means that he alone stands openly for Yahweh against the many. He says the same later in despair (19:10, 14).

decisions.choice: I am the only one left (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The repeated "I" stresses that Elijah stands alone. Balanced and Readable carry the stress by "the only". Elijah's words run on to verse 24.
Literal spells the number out as the Hebrew does; Balanced and Readable write figures, as the style guide sets.

source.text: וְיִתְּנוּ־לָ֜נוּ שְׁנַ֣יִם פָּרִ֗ים וְיִבְחֲר֣וּ לָהֶם֩ הַפָּ֨ר הָאֶחָ֜ד וִֽינַתְּחֻ֗הוּ וְיָשִׂ֨ימוּ֙ עַל־הָ֣עֵצִ֔ים וְאֵ֖שׁ לֹ֣א יָשִׂ֑ימוּ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה׀אֶת־הַפָּ֣ר הָאֶחָ֗ד וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ עַל־הָ֣עֵצִ֔ים וְאֵ֖שׁ לֹ֥א אָשִֽׂים׃

records.literal_gloss: And let them give to us two bulls, and let them choose for themselves the bull the one and cut it in pieces and put [it] on the wood, and fire not they shall put; and I, I will prepare the bull the one and give [it] on the wood, and fire not I will put.

en.L: And let them give us two bulls, and let them choose the one bull for themselves and cut it in pieces and put [it] on the wood, but they shall not put fire [to it]. And I will prepare the other bull and lay [it] on the wood, but I will not put fire [to it].
en.B: Have two bulls brought to us. Let the prophets of Baal pick one of the bulls for themselves, cut it up, and set it on the wood, without lighting a fire. I will get the other bull ready and set it on the wood, and I too will light no fire.
en.R: Bring us two bulls. Baal's prophets may choose one of them. They must cut it into pieces and put it on the wood, but they must not light the fire. I will get the other bull ready and put it on the wood. I will not light a fire either.

es.L: Que se nos den dos toros, y que ellos escojan para sí uno de los toros y lo despedacen y [lo] pongan sobre la leña, pero no pongan fuego; y yo prepararé el otro toro y [lo] pondré sobre la leña, pero no pondré fuego.
es.B: Que nos traigan dos toros. Que los profetas de Baal escojan uno para ellos, lo corten en pedazos y lo pongan sobre la leña, sin encender fuego. Yo prepararé el otro toro y lo pondré sobre la leña, y tampoco encenderé fuego.
es.R: Que nos traigan dos toros. Los profetas de Baal pueden escoger uno. Deben cortarlo en pedazos y ponerlo sobre la leña, pero no deben encender el fuego. Yo prepararé el otro toro y lo pondré sobre la leña. Yo tampoco encenderé el fuego.

fr.L: Qu’on nous donne deux taureaux ; qu’ils choisissent pour eux l’un des taureaux, qu’ils le coupent en morceaux et [le] mettent sur le bois, mais qu’ils n’y mettent pas le feu. Et moi, je préparerai l’autre taureau et [le] mettrai sur le bois, et je n’y mettrai pas le feu.
fr.B: Qu’on nous amène deux taureaux. Que les prophètes de Baal en choisissent un pour eux, qu’ils le coupent en morceaux et le posent sur le bois, sans allumer le feu. Moi, je préparerai l’autre taureau, je le poserai sur le bois, et je n’allumerai pas non plus de feu.
fr.R: Amenez-nous deux taureaux. Les prophètes de Baal en choisiront un. Ils le couperont en morceaux et le mettront sur le bois, mais ils ne devront pas allumer le feu. Moi, je préparerai l’autre taureau et je le mettrai sur le bois. Je n’allumerai pas le feu, moi non plus.

sw.L: Basi na watupe mafahali wawili, nao wajichagulie fahali mmoja, wamkate vipande vipande, wamweke juu ya kuni, lakini wasitie moto. Nami nitamwandaa yule fahali mwingine, nimweke juu ya kuni, lakini sitatia moto.
sw.B: Tuletewe mafahali wawili. Manabii wa Baali wajichagulie fahali mmoja, wamkate vipande vipande, wamweke juu ya kuni bila kuwasha moto. Nami nitamwandaa yule fahali mwingine, nimweke juu ya kuni, nami pia sitawasha moto.
sw.R: Tuleteeni mafahali wawili. Manabii wa Baali wachague mmoja wao. Wamkate vipande vipande na kumweka juu ya kuni, lakini wasiwashe moto. Nami nitamwandaa yule fahali mwingine na kumweka juu ya kuni. Mimi pia sitawasha moto.

vi.L: Hãy cho chúng tôi hai con bò đực; họ hãy chọn cho mình một con, chặt ra từng miếng, đặt [lên] củi, nhưng không được châm lửa. Còn tôi, tôi sẽ sửa soạn con bò kia và đặt [lên] củi, nhưng tôi sẽ không châm lửa.
vi.B: Hãy đem đến cho chúng tôi hai con bò đực. Các nhà tiên tri của Ba-anh hãy chọn một con, chặt ra từng miếng và đặt lên củi, nhưng không được nhóm lửa. Tôi sẽ sửa soạn con bò kia, đặt lên củi, và tôi cũng không nhóm lửa.
vi.R: Hãy đem đến cho chúng tôi hai con bò đực. Các nhà tiên tri của Ba-anh được chọn một con. Họ phải chặt con bò ra từng miếng và đặt lên củi, nhưng không được nhóm lửa. Tôi sẽ sửa soạn con bò kia và đặt lên củi. Tôi cũng sẽ không nhóm lửa.

ko.L: 그러니 그들이 우리에게 수소 두 마리를 주게 하여라. 그들이 자기들을 위해 수소 한 마리를 골라 각을 떠서 나무 위에 놓되 불은 붙이지 말게 하여라. 나도 다른 수소 한 마리를 잡아 나무 위에 놓되 불은 붙이지 않겠다.
ko.B: 우리에게 수소 두 마리를 가져오게 하여라. 바알의 예언자들이 그 가운데 한 마리를 골라 각을 떠서 나무 위에 올려놓되, 불은 붙이지 말게 하여라. 나도 나머지 수소 한 마리를 잡아 나무 위에 올려놓고, 불은 붙이지 않겠다.
ko.R: 수소 두 마리를 가져오너라. 바알의 예언자들이 그중 한 마리를 고르게 하여라. 그들은 그것을 여러 조각으로 잘라 나무 위에 올려놓아야 한다. 그러나 불은 붙이지 말아야 한다. 나도 다른 수소 한 마리를 잡아 나무 위에 올려놓겠다. 나도 불은 붙이지 않겠다.

pt.L: Que nos deem, pois, dois novilhos, e que eles escolham para si um novilho, e o cortem em pedaços, e [o] ponham sobre a lenha, mas fogo não porão; e eu prepararei o outro novilho e [o] porei sobre a lenha, mas fogo não porei.
pt.B: Tragam-nos dois novilhos. Que os profetas de Baal escolham um deles, cortem-no em pedaços e o coloquem sobre a lenha, mas sem acender o fogo. Eu prepararei o outro novilho e o colocarei sobre a lenha, e também não acenderei o fogo.
pt.R: Tragam dois novilhos para nós. Os profetas de Baal podem escolher um deles. Eles devem cortá-lo em pedaços e colocá-lo sobre a lenha, mas não podem acender o fogo. Eu vou preparar o outro novilho e colocá-lo sobre a lenha. Eu também não vou acender o fogo.

am.L: ሁለትም ወይፈኖች ይስጡን፤ እነርሱም አንዱን ወይፈን ለራሳቸው ይምረጡ፤ ይቁረጡትም፤ በእንጨቱም ላይ ያድርጉት፤ እሳት ግን አያድርጉበት፤ እኔም ሌላውን ወይፈን አዘጋጃለሁ፤ በእንጨቱም ላይ አደርገዋለሁ፤ እሳት ግን አላደርግበትም።
am.B: ሁለት ወይፈኖች ይምጡልን። የበኣል ነቢያት ከወይፈኖቹ አንዱን ለራሳቸው መርጠው ይቁረጡት፤ በእንጨቱም ላይ ያኑሩት፤ እሳት ግን አያንድዱ። እኔም ሌላውን ወይፈን አዘጋጅቼ በእንጨቱ ላይ አኖረዋለሁ፤ እኔም እሳት አላነድም።
am.R: ሁለት ወይፈኖች አምጡልን። የበኣል ነቢያት ከእነርሱ አንዱን ይምረጡ። ቆራርጠውም በእንጨቱ ላይ ያስቀምጡት፤ እሳቱን ግን አያንድዱ። እኔም ሌላውን ወይፈን አዘጋጅቼ በእንጨቱ ላይ አስቀምጠዋለሁ። እኔም እሳት አላነድም።

hi.L: और [कोई] हमें दो बैल दे, और वे अपने लिए एक बैल चुन लें, और उसके टुकड़े-टुकड़े करके लकड़ी पर रखें, पर आग न लगाएँ। और मैं दूसरे बैल को तैयार करके लकड़ी पर रखूँगा, और आग न लगाऊँगा।
hi.B: हमारे लिए दो बैल लाए जाएँ। बाल के भविष्यद्वक्ता उनमें से एक बैल अपने लिए चुन लें, उसके टुकड़े करें और उसे लकड़ी पर रखें, पर आग न लगाएँ। मैं दूसरा बैल तैयार करके लकड़ी पर रखूँगा, और मैं भी आग नहीं लगाऊँगा।
hi.R: हमारे लिए दो बैल लाओ। बाल के नबी उनमें से एक को चुन लें। वे उसके टुकड़े करके लकड़ी पर रखें, पर आग न लगाएँ। मैं दूसरे बैल को तैयार करके लकड़ी पर रखूँगा। मैं भी आग नहीं लगाऊँगा।

ru.L: Пусть дадут нам двух быков, и пусть выберут себе одного быка, и рассекут его на части, и положат на дрова, а огня пусть не подкладывают. А я приготовлю другого быка и положу на дрова, и огня не подложу.
ru.B: Пусть нам приведут двух быков. Пусть пророки Ваала выберут себе одного, рассекут его и положат на дрова, но огня не разводят. А я приготовлю другого быка, положу его на дрова и тоже не стану разводить огонь.
ru.R: Приведите нам двух быков. Пусть пророки Ваала выберут себе одного. Пусть они разрубят его на куски и положат на дрова, но огонь не зажигают. А я приготовлю другого быка и положу его на дрова. Я тоже не стану зажигать огонь.

uk.L: Хай дадуть нам двох бичків, і хай виберуть собі одного бичка, і розітнуть його на частини, і покладуть на дрова, а вогню хай не підкладають. А я приготую другого бичка і покладу на дрова, і вогню не підкладу.
uk.B: Хай приведуть нам двох бичків. Нехай пророки Ваала виберуть собі одного з бичків, розітнуть його і покладуть на дрова, не розпалюючи вогню. Я приготую другого бичка і покладу на дрова, і я теж не розпалюватиму вогню.
uk.R: Приведіть нам двох бичків. Пророки Ваала хай виберуть одного з них. Вони мають розітнути його на частини і покласти на дрова, але не розпалювати вогню. Я приготую другого бичка і покладу його на дрова. Я теж не розпалюватиму вогню.

decisions.choice: let them give ... let them choose: the first "they" is anyone, the second is Baal's prophets
decisions.reason: The first verb is impersonal: "let two bulls be given". The ones who choose are the prophets of Baal, as verse 25 makes clear.

decisions.choice: bulls cut in pieces: prepared as burnt offerings
decisions.reason: The bull was cut up and laid on the wood as for a burnt offering (Leviticus 1:6-8). The only thing missing is the fire, which each god must send.

decisions.choice: no fire: the test is which god sends fire
decisions.reason: Fire from Yahweh had consumed the first offerings at the tabernacle (Leviticus 9:24). Baal was worshiped as a storm god who sent lightning. The test is set where Baal was thought strongest.

decisions.choice: the prophets of Baal (Balanced); Baal's prophets (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who "they" are.

source.text: וּקְרָאתֶ֞ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א בְשֵׁם־יְהוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֧ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲנֶ֥ה בָאֵ֖שׁ ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּ֧עַן כָּל־הָעָ֛ם וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ ט֥וֹב הַדָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will call on [the] name of your god, and I, I will call on [the] name of Yahweh; and it will be, the god who answers by fire, he [is] the God. And answered all the people and said, Good [is] the word.

en.L: And you will call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and it will be, the god who answers by fire, he [is] God." And all the people answered and said, "The word [is] good."
en.B: Then you call on your god by name, and I will call on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Whichever god answers with fire, he is God." All the people answered, "That is well said."
en.R: Then you pray to your god, and I will pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The god who answers by sending fire is the real God." All the people said, "That is a good idea!"

es.L: E {{plural_you:invocarán ustedes|invocaréis vosotros}} el nombre de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} dios, y yo invocaré el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y sucederá que el dios que responda con fuego, ese [es] Dios». Y todo el pueblo respondió y dijo: «Buena [es] la palabra».
es.B: Luego {{plural_you:ustedes invoquen|vosotros invocad}} a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} dios por su nombre, y yo invocaré el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. El dios que responda con fuego, ese es Dios». Todo el pueblo respondió: «Bien dicho».
es.R: Luego {{plural_you:ustedes oren|vosotros orad}} a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} dios, y yo oraré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. El dios que responda enviando fuego es el Dios verdadero». Todo el pueblo dijo: «¡Buena idea!».

fr.L: Et vous invoquerez le nom de votre dieu, et moi j’invoquerai le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et le dieu qui répondra par le feu, c’est lui [qui est] Dieu. » Et tout le peuple répondit et dit : « La parole [est] bonne. »
fr.B: Ensuite vous invoquerez votre dieu par son nom, et moi j’invoquerai le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Le dieu qui répondra par le feu, c’est lui qui est Dieu. » Tout le peuple répondit : « C’est bien parlé. »
fr.R: Ensuite vous prierez votre dieu, et moi je prierai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Le dieu qui répondra en envoyant le feu sera le vrai Dieu. » Tout le peuple a dit : « C’est une bonne idée ! »

sw.L: Nanyi mtaliitia jina la mungu wenu, nami nitaliitia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; itakuwa, mungu atakayejibu kwa moto, yeye [ndiye] Mungu." Watu wote wakajibu wakasema, "Neno [hili ni] jema."
sw.B: Kisha ninyi liitieni jina la mungu wenu, nami nitaliitia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mungu atakayejibu kwa moto, yeye ndiye Mungu." Watu wote wakajibu, "Umesema vema."
sw.R: Kisha ninyi mwombeni mungu wenu, nami nitamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mungu atakayejibu kwa kutuma moto ndiye Mungu wa kweli." Watu wote wakasema, "Hilo ni wazo zuri!"

vi.L: Các người sẽ kêu cầu danh thần của các người, còn tôi sẽ kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; thần nào đáp lời bằng lửa, thần ấy [là] Đức Chúa Trời." Cả dân chúng đáp: "Lời [ấy] hay lắm."
vi.B: Rồi các người hãy kêu cầu danh thần của mình, còn tôi sẽ kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Thần nào đáp lời bằng lửa, thần ấy là Đức Chúa Trời." Cả dân chúng đáp: "Nói hay lắm."
vi.R: Rồi các người hãy cầu nguyện với thần của các người, còn tôi sẽ cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Thần nào đáp lời bằng cách cho lửa xuống, thần ấy là Đức Chúa Trời thật." Cả dân chúng nói: "Ý ấy hay lắm!"

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 너희 신의 이름을 불러라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르겠다. 불로 응답하는 신, 그가 하나님이시다." 그러자 모든 백성이 대답하여 말했다. "그 말이 좋습니다."
ko.B: 그런 다음 너희는 너희 신의 이름을 불러라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르겠다. 불로 응답하는 신이 하나님이시다." 그러자 모든 백성이 대답했다. "좋은 말씀입니다."
ko.R: 그다음에 너희는 너희 신에게 기도하여라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하겠다. 불을 내려 응답하는 신이 참 하나님이시다." 모든 백성이 말했다. "좋습니다!"

pt.L: E vocês invocarão o nome do deus de vocês, e eu invocarei o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; e será [que] o deus que responder com fogo, esse [é] Deus." E todo o povo respondeu e disse: "Boa [é] a palavra."
pt.B: Depois vocês invocarão o deus de vocês pelo nome, e eu invocarei o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. O deus que responder com fogo, esse é Deus." Todo o povo respondeu: "Está bem dito!"
pt.R: Depois vocês vão orar ao deus de vocês, e eu vou orar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. O deus que responder mandando fogo é o Deus verdadeiro." Todo o povo disse: "É uma boa ideia!"

am.L: እናንተም የአምላካችሁን ስም ትጠራላችሁ፤ እኔም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም እጠራለሁ፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በእሳት የሚመልስ አምላክ እርሱ አምላክ [ነው]።» ሕዝቡም ሁሉ መልሰው፦ «ቃሉ መልካም [ነው]» አሉ።
am.B: ከዚያም እናንተ የአምላካችሁን ስም ጥሩ፤ እኔም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም እጠራለሁ። በእሳት የሚመልሰው አምላክ እርሱ አምላክ ነው።» ሕዝቡም ሁሉ፦ «መልካም ተናገርህ» ብለው መለሱ።
am.R: ከዚያም እናንተ ወደ አምላካችሁ ጸልዩ፤ እኔም ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እጸልያለሁ። እሳት በመላክ የሚመልሰው አምላክ እርሱ እውነተኛው አምላክ ነው።» ሕዝቡም ሁሉ፦ «ጥሩ ሐሳብ ነው!» አሉ።

hi.L: और तुम अपने देवता का नाम लेकर पुकारना, और मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का नाम लेकर पुकारूँगा; और ऐसा होगा कि जो ईश्वर आग से उत्तर दे, वही परमेश्वर [है]।" और सब लोगों ने उत्तर दिया, "बात अच्छी [है]।"
hi.B: तब तुम अपने देवता का नाम लेकर पुकारना, और मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का नाम लेकर पुकारूँगा। जो ईश्वर आग भेजकर उत्तर दे, वही परमेश्वर है।" सब लोगों ने उत्तर दिया, "ठीक कहा।"
hi.R: तब तुम अपने देवता से प्रार्थना करना, और मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना करूँगा। जो ईश्वर आग भेजकर जवाब दे, वही सच्चा परमेश्वर है।" सब लोगों ने कहा, "यह अच्छी बात है!"

ru.L: И призовёте вы имя вашего бога, а я призову имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. И будет: бог, который ответит огнём, — тот и Бог.» И ответил весь народ и сказал: «Хорошо это слово.»
ru.B: Потом вы призовёте вашего бога по имени, а я призову имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Тот бог, который ответит огнём, — он и есть Бог.» И весь народ ответил: «Хорошо сказано.»
ru.R: Потом вы помолитесь вашему богу, а я помолюсь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Тот бог, который ответит и пошлёт огонь, — настоящий Бог.» И весь народ сказал: «Хорошо, так и сделаем!»

uk.L: І ви кличте імʼя вашого бога, а я кликатиму імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; і буде: бог, який відповість вогнем, — він Бог». І відповів увесь народ, і сказав: «Добре слово».
uk.B: Тоді ви кличте свого бога на імʼя, а я кликатиму імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Котрий бог відповість вогнем, той і є Бог». Увесь народ відповів: «Добре сказано».
uk.R: Тоді ви молітеся своєму богові, а я молитимуся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}. Бог, який відповість, пославши вогонь, — той і є справжній Бог». Увесь народ сказав: «Це добра думка!»

decisions.choice: call on the name: pray to, invoke
decisions.reason: To call on a god's name is to pray to him and ask for his help (Genesis 12:8; Psalm 116:4).

decisions.choice: the god who answers by fire is God: the test of who is truly God
decisions.reason: The first "god" is general, whichever god answers; the second has the article, "the God", the true God (verse 21). The fire will settle the question.

decisions.choice: you: the prophets of Baal and those who follow Baal
decisions.reason: "Your god" is plural: it means Baal's side, whose prophets will act for them (verse 25).

decisions.choice: the word is good: the people agree
decisions.reason: The phrase accepts a proposal (Deuteronomy 1:14; 1 Kings 2:38). The people who would not answer Elijah (verse 21) now agree to the test.

decisions.choice: he: not marked as a pronoun for God
decisions.reason: The god who answers is not yet named; the pronoun refers to whichever god it will be, so it takes no capital in any setting.

decisions.choice: "ese es Dios", with no deity_pronoun span
